Algorhythm (www.algorhythm.io) DBA Hello Insight is an “impact science” company that combines rigorous applied evaluation methods, next generation analytics, and real-time technologies to deliver accurate insights and actionable solutions to those working directly with children, youth and families.  Since our inception in 2013, Algorhythm DBA Hello Insight's overarching philosophy and approach are best characterized as utilization focused, applied and participatory, with a strong commitment to creating ongoing collaborative learning environments that foster the development of staff, programs, organizations, and fields of practice.  Our automated, online learning platform Hello Insight (www.helloinsight.org) equips out-of-school and in-school programs with research-based tools and analytics that have been tested and validated with nearly 1,000 peer organizations around the country.  These tools measure a wide range of research-based social and emotional learning (SEL) outcomes and positive youth development (PYD) practices for youth serving programs, including:

? Arts programs
? Camps
? Career Workforce Readiness programs 
? College Readiness programs
? Leadership programs
? Literacy programs
? Sports Based Youth Development (SBYD) programs
? Mentoring programs
? Writing programs
? Youth Leadership and Action (or Youth-led Social Change) programs

Hello Insight supports organizations and programs to:

? Share in a common set of valid and standardized metrics of social and emotional learning outcomes and positive youth development practices that have been developed with peer programs, staff and youth;
? Conduct a cost-effective program evaluation through a user-friendly online platform that offers surveys via any internet-accessible device or by paper surveys (also available in multiple languages);
? Understand youth assets and growth potential, at the beginning of programming;
? Access highly accurate predictive and prescriptive analytic models;
? Use data-driven PYD recommendations, generated by artificial intelligence (AI) technology, that leverage an ever-growing dataset to identify what has worked for youth with similar attributes;
? Access rigorously analyzed pre/post matched data, that highlight significant growth, and provide benchmarks;
? Communicate findings, insights and priority recommendations to various stakeholders, including: youth, families, staff, board members, and funders; and
? Contribute to and benefit from a rapidly growing shared dataset. As a collective, we share our findings locally, regionally and nationally and ignite national discussions to amplify the work of our partners and their learnings to support the larger youth development field.

Hello Insight is widely adopted, especially in New York City.  Algorhythm is a preferred assessment partner with the YMCA of the USA and is engaged with more than 200 Ys across the country.  In addition, numerous foundations and national membership organizations have supported local partners to participate in Hello Insight, for example:  NYC Service, The New York Community Trust, Youth INC, Vita Sports Partners/VITA Hub NYC, Laureus Sport for Good Foundation, The Chicago Cubs, The LA Dodgers Foundation, Camp Fire, BUILD, The Funders Collaborative on Youth Organizing (FCYO), Philadelphia Youth Sports Collaborative, Elma Philanthropies, and Newark Thrives. In partnership with NYU Metro Center (The Metropolitan Center for Research on Equity and the Transformation of Schools), our tools are currently being used as part of several, multi-year studies being supported by the W.T. Grant Foundation, Institute for Education Science (IES), and the Kellogg Foundation. 

Our founders and leadership team have more than fifty years of collective expertise and experience in providing applied research and evaluation services, especially in NYC, before creating Algorhythm.  In addition to the cost-effective Hello Insight measurement system, Algorhythm provides services, including: evaluation planning; logic model development; quantitative and qualitative tool development and analysis; participatory evaluation strategies that engage children, youth, families, and communities in evaluation and making meaning of data; data communication; and, support for data-driven learning and improvement at all levels - across fields of practices, for organizational leaders, program leaders, boards, funders, and frontline staff.

business_description:
ArchForKids Mission: Through engaging learning programs, ArchForKids spurs young people to explore how the built world around them affects who they are and how they live. As young tecture walks and construct skyscrapers and sustainable cities, they apply academic concepts to real world situations. In addition, they gain a deeper understanding – and appreciation – of their own communities and the wider world.

Organizational background:  ArchForKids was established in 2013 by architect/educator Janny Gedeon and arts administrator Kathryn Slocum. It is a leading provider of STEAM (science/tech/engineering/art + design /math) programs in the New York metro area.  ArchForKids also provides a range of virtual programs to audiences across the country and world.

Why architecture? Architecture surrounds us - it is relevant, easily accessible and tangible. Math, science, social studies and art/design are all embedded in the built world.  Architecture is both an art and a highly technical field. Most kids like building things, feeling the accomplishment of problem-solving and creating something interesting, useful and beautiful. Architecture is a great medium for all kinds of learning and doing. 

Moreover, the built world can be used to support school curriculum and to make connections between schools, young people and the wider community. Involving children in design decisions about the places in which they live, learn and play can produce inspiring buildings that instill a sense of ownership and civic engagement. 

Our process: In ArchForKids offerings, young designers investigate, explore, measure, estimate, design, draw, calculate and construct. They go on neighborhood investigations, design parks and dream houses, propose uses for vacant lots, and much more. Our architect-educators teach core academic subjects through projects that deepen student understanding of the built world. Through this “hands-on, minds-on” approach to education, we encourage students to use design thinking and to become critical thinkers, creative makers and lifelong learners. 

ArchForKids programs are designed to:
• Use the local community as a living classroom
• Reach all styles of learners
• Use the design process to solve problems and challenges
• Sharpen STEAM content and knowledge
• Introduce children to the tools and strategies used by architects and engineers
• Extend/enrich school curricula and align with common core standards
• Improve ELA skills through journal writing/sharing and presentation of work 
• Nurture knowledge and appreciation for the aesthetics, history and function of communities
• Expose young people to potential careers related to the built environment

Our programs and partners: ArchForKids programs include in-school residencies, afterschool studios, library and museum workshops, all-day design challenges and more. We work with schools in New York City and Westchester County. In addition, ArchForKids has ongoing partnerships with the Brooklyn, Queens, New York and Westchester Public Libraries; City of Mount Vernon Youth Bureau and Tarrytown Summer Arts Camp. ArchForKids has served as artists/educators in residence for the Smithsonian National Museum of the American Indian (NYC), the Hudson River Museum (Yonkers) and the High Line in Manhattan. ArchForKids works virtually with the nonprofit LEAD Coalition and the City of Panama City FL, leading charrettes in which teens re-imagine their community.

ARCHI-TECTONICS NYC, LLC - "Most Talk About Innovation; We DO Innovation"

Archi-Tectonics is an architectural design firm founded in 1994 by Winka Dubbeldam, with offices in New York City, Amsterdam/ the Netherlands, and Hangzhou/ China.

HOW WE THINK

We love to build. We operate at multiple scales of investigation, ranging from object design or architectural and building scale, to the planning of complex urban systems. Our methodology is deeply committed to research and extensive prototyping throughout all design stages. This analytical approach allows us to develop highly optimized, intelligent structures and morphologies, while promoting the emergence of a singular character and identity for each project.

The wide range of completed work worldwide is a testament to the strength of our research-based approach, and our ambition to create genuinely innovative typologies, spaces and materials, as well as uniquely evocative and transformative environments - Architecture that matters.

Our focus is not on style or a recognizable “signature” but on a process that combines creativity with technological advancements, resulting in what we call “poetic precision". We value performance over form, design intelligence over style.

We create great value for our clients and users, by providing efficient, sustainable, and at the same time strikingly beautiful solutions, often prominently enhancing the brand identity of our commercial clients. All our projects have proven to multiply the Return on Investment already at the time of completion. 

We are convinced that sustainability is an indisputable obligation to the world we live in, but also a great engine for innovation. Archi-Tectonics is an expert in LEED design and we are passionate about the use of smart systems and sustainable materials to create energy efficient, healthy living environments. 


HOW WE WORK

While intuition and skill remain at the core of our design process, we supplant and supplement this knowledge with advanced digital form-generating and prototyping tools, merging into what we consider Digital Craft.  This methodology allows us to expand beyond accepted architectural convention, opening the possibility of genuine innovation and discovery, while benefiting from the extensive construction knowledge we have developed over the years.

Our work occupies a space between machine-like intelligence and organic embodiment. We like to think that our designs have “character”,  an identity that helps brand our client’s company concept, as well as create resale value. We are proud that our clients typically report a multiple return on investment (200 -300%).

Artech is a minority- and women-owned business enterprise (MWBE) and is ranked the #1 largest women-owned IT staffing firm in the US and the #11 largest IT staffing firm in the US by Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA).  The company is very active in the diversity community and its president, Ranjini Poddar, has served on the WBENC Board of Directors and was the WBE Co-chair for the WBENC National Conference in 2009 and again in 2013. Artech is an NMSDC Corporate Plus® member and won the prestigious NMSDC National Supplier of the Year award in 2009 – this is the highest honor a minority supplier can receive.  Artech is also certified by the Women’s Business Enterprise National Council (WBENC), and the California Public Utilities Commission (CPUC).  

As the largest woman-owned IT Staffing firm in the United States, Artech is committed, both in practice and in principle, to helping underrepresented populations of workers explore and expand their careers in Information Technology and other STEM disciplines. As a supplier, Artech provides a platform for diversity spend that goes beyond our certification as both Woman and Minority owned.  While diverse supply chain initiatives help meet both internal diversity spend initiatives, Artech focuses on the gains that can be made in actual worker participation rates. 

Artech currently employs over 6,400 contractors coast-to-coast across the U.S., supporting more than 85 Fortune 500 and government clients.  Artech’s global headquarters is in located Morristown, NJ, and the firm maintains a strategic presence up and down the eastern seaboard in Massachusetts, New York, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Virginia, North Carolina, Georgia, and Florida.  In the Midwest and Southwest, Artech has several offices in major metropolitan areas such as Chicago, Minneapolis, Dallas, and Phoenix.  On the West Coast, Artech is strongly represented by five offices / service delivery centers in California, Arizona and Washington.

Artech has extensive staff augmentation experience in both IT and non-IT categories.  Artech provides a variety of workforce solutions to meet the needs of its clients in support of job categories such as Information Technology (IT); Engineering; Professional and Managerial; Scientific, Clinical and regulatory; HR; Legal; Sales and Marketing; Design; and Finance and Accounting.   

Artech supports a variety of commercial and government clients, including over 85 Fortune 500 and Global 500 clients worldwide.  Besides its leadership in staff augmentation services in areas such as IT, Professional and Engineering, Artech also specializes in supporting such niche areas as big data, business intelligence and data warehousing, cloud computing, mobility, and ERP solutions for clients such as IBM, Intel, Accenture, Wells Fargo, Google, Best Buy, Expedia, Capital One, DXC Technology, Texas Instruments, Microsoft, and others.

All Artech services are supported by a holistic workflow methodology that ties together its dedicated team structure and single point of contact, mature recruiting process, and cutting-edge tools (people, processes and technology) to generate one continuous workflow stream.

Over the last 32 years, Artech has grown every year because of its strong belief in investments into new and innovative technology platforms, human capital, process driven operations management, and conservative financial policies. We recognize that clients’ problems are layered and require integrated solutions whether they are legal, commercial, financial, or their liberty is at risk. - Securities Enforcement & Regulatory. Our lawyers leverage their experience at federal and state regulatory agencies to advise clients about financial products and services litigation that accompany industrywide inquiries.
- Trials, Arbitrations and Mediation. Our lawyers have extensive litigation experience in state and federal courts nationwide.
- Employment Counseling and Litigation. We have led internal investigations, defended claims of discrimination,
sexual harassment and wrongful termination, and prepared severance agreements for clients. We also provide guidance on talent management strategies designed to mitigate risk.
- Risk and Crisis Management. Our attorneys focus on risk and crisis management to mitigate litigation and reputational risk. We advise boards of directors and management teams on reputation
management and managing public perception and help to craft clients’ media strategy.

We are committed to staying at the forefront of educational innovation, continuously exploring new tools and methods to improve student outcomes.

We partner with local schools, community organizations, and other stakeholders to identify and address the educational needs of our community. Our initiatives aim to close the achievement gap, promote lifelong learning, and contribute to the overall well-being and prosperity of our community.

Future Goals:
Looking ahead, BrainBridge aims to expand our reach and impact by:

Launching new programs and services to address emerging educational needs.
Building stronger partnerships with schools, businesses, and community organizations.
Continuing to innovate and integrate new technologies to enhance our offerings.
Scaling our operations to serve a broader student population across New York City and beyond.
Conclusion:
BrainBridge is committed to revolutionizing education through innovation, personalized learning, and community engagement. business_description:
Dr. Byte Technologies is a company founded on the belief that technology should serve humanity, not the other way around. Our mission is to "Engineer Chaos into Harmony," and our motto is to "Make Every Bit Count." We are an organization dedicated to creating technology that empowers individuals and businesses, allowing them to free up time to pursue what they love and achieve a better "Life Work Balance." We are uniquely qualified to build this business because our approach is not just about technical solutions; it's about solving real-world pain points and creating a more harmonious, secure, and efficient digital world.

Our business is built upon a foundation of five core technical pillars: Infrastructure, Software, Web, Cybersecurity, and AI. Each of these pillars is infused with our overarching philosophy of empowerment, efficiency, and humanity-centricity.

The 5 Pillars of Dr. Byte Technologies and Our Core Offerings

Infrastructure: We engineer robust, scalable, and resilient infrastructure solutions that are the backbone of any modern enterprise. By focusing on efficiency and optimal resource utilization, we create systems that minimize downtime and streamline operations. Our expertise in complex projects, including Tier 4 data centers, allows us to provide a comprehensive foundation that frees up IT teams for strategic initiatives.

Software: Our approach to software development is rooted in a user-centered design philosophy. We create intuitive, user-friendly software that simplifies complex tasks and enhances productivity. Our solutions are designed to empower users and support a healthy work-life balance by eliminating cumbersome workflows. This includes developing bespoke solutions, such as our AI-powered dashboards and digital transformation services.

Web: We design and implement secure, accessible, and engaging web experiences that prioritize human connection and user needs. Our web platforms are built to serve humanity by providing seamless interactions and valuable information, whether for a commercial, residential, or industrial facility.

Cybersecurity: We believe that security is not an afterthought but a foundational element of engineering. We integrate proactive cybersecurity measures into every project from the ground up, protecting data and systems from evolving threats. Our unified Security Operations Center (SOC) team handles both security compliance and active monitoring, utilizing tools like SIEM, SOAR, EDR, and IDS/IPS to provide a resilient, proactive security posture. This approach helps lower insurance premiums for clients and ensures a secure environment.

AI (Artificial Intelligence): We develop and deploy ethical AI solutions that augment human capabilities and automate repetitive tasks. Our AI is engineered to serve humanity by enhancing efficiency, providing valuable insights, and promoting well-being, all while adhering to the highest ethical standards. This includes developing AI-powered service agents for proactive issue detection and support.

Key Differentiators and Community Impact

Our unique differentiators extend beyond our technical capabilities:

Philosophy of Empowerment: Our core belief is that technology should empower people. We design and build solutions that genuinely free up our clients' time, allowing them to focus on their core business and passions.

Innovative Culture: We have a dedicated space for innovation, research, and classes. This allows us to rapidly prototype solutions and provide clients with access to cutting-edge technologies. Our commitment to innovation is further demonstrated through our community tech literacy centers and labs.

Security as a Foundation: As mentioned, security is built into our engineering DNA. This proactive approach benefits clients by creating a resilient environment that helps prevent costly breaches and fosters trust.

Conservation-Focused Initiatives: Our land on a nature preserve is a living lab for research in renewable energy, new technologies, and nature preservation. This commitment to sustainability translates into our projects and aligns our business with a regenerative future where technology thrives in harmony with the planet.

In addition to our core services, we are proud to have a strong track record, having completed projects for notable clients such as Durst, Disney, and Fox. We are also fully capable of handling projects with union, government, prevailing wage, and government labor harmony requirements.

Dr. Byte Technologies is more than a technology company; we are a partner in our clients' success, transforming digital chaos into harmony and ensuring that every bit counts for a better, more efficient, and more human-centered world.

business_description:
Cakesnstufff is a woman-owned, minority-owned business built on a deep passion for creativity, community, and craftsmanship. Founded by a first-generation Dominican-American woman, Cakesnstufff represents the strength, determination, and creativity passed down from one generation to the next. My mother immigrated to the United States from the Dominican Republic as a single mother, and her perseverance continues to inspire everything I do as the first person in my family to own and operate my own business.

What began as a home-based bakery has evolved into a multifaceted brand that brings people together through the art of baking and hands-on learning.

At Cakesnstufff, we specialize in scratch-made baked goods crafted with care and attention to detail. Every treat is made using minimal, high-quality ingredients—always fresh, never mass-produced. Our products are known for their balanced sweetness, unique flavor profiles, and beautiful presentation. From cookies and cupcakes to custom desserts, each creation delivers a memorable experience that looks as good as it tastes.

Beyond baking, Cakesnstufff is deeply committed to education and community engagement. We offer a variety of baking and decorating classes for both children and adults, including after-school programs, family workshops, and day sessions. These classes give students the chance to explore their creativity, build confidence, and develop practical skills in a fun, supportive environment.

Working with children is one of the most rewarding parts of what we do. I believe every child deserves opportunities that spark imagination, curiosity, and joy—especially experiences that connect art and science. Through our STEM-inspired baking and decorating workshops, students learn about measurement, chemistry, design, and problem-solving in a hands-on, creative way. Our goal is to show that learning can be both educational and delicious.

Cakesnstufff also hosts community-based and family events, such as sip-and-decorate sessions, pop-up classes, and interactive dessert experiences. These events bring families together to create, learn, and make lasting memories.

At its heart, Cakesnstufff stands for inclusion, creativity, and opportunity. My mission is to share the Cakesnstufff experience with as many people as possible—especially children and families who may not always have access to these types of programs. Through every dessert, class, and community event, I strive to celebrate baking, inspire learning, and spread joy one bake at a time.

business_description:
Carter Lard Consulting (CLC) is a certified Minority Business Enterprise (MBE) and Disadvantaged Business Enterprise (DBE) providing comprehensive consulting, staffing, and community development solutions across the public and private sectors. With over 30 years of combined experience, our multidisciplinary team delivers targeted, measurable, and sustainable outcomes that empower communities, enhance compliance, and strengthen institutional performance.

As a certified MBE and DBE, CLC specializes in a wide range of staffing solutions and related services designed to meet complex workforce and organizational needs. Our staffing division provides temporary and executive staffing, payrolling, background checks, PEO (Professional Employer Organization) services, workforce development, and specialized workforce training. We staff across multiple sectors including accounting, clerical, administration, architecture and engineering, construction, healthcare, human services, case management, information technology, legal, and finance. This breadth allows us to deliver adaptable and scalable solutions to diverse clients, from small community programs to large-scale government contracts.

CLC is also a trusted provider of emergency housing, disaster recovery, and supportive housing programs. We coordinate mobile outreach, shelter management, and relocation services while integrating case management, mental health support, and substance use recovery programs. Our Supportive Housing and Wraparound Services extend to affordable and low-income housing initiatives and are designed to align with tax incentive programs such as ICAP (MBE), LIHTC, SLIHC, J-51, and 420/421. Through these programs, we help housing developers, property managers, and government partners meet their compliance, case management, and social service delivery requirements efficiently and compassionately.

In addition, CLC offers occupational health services, including the operation and staffing of workplace and community-based clinics. We support both preventive and responsive healthcare initiatives to improve workforce health, safety, and overall productivity. Our team’s expertise in mental health, substance abuse, and addiction recovery ensures that our workforce and case management programs maintain a holistic, person-centered approach that addresses both immediate needs and long-term outcomes.

CLC’s compliance, risk, and administrative management services help clients navigate the complex regulatory environments governing MWBE programs, labor laws, and public-sector contracting. We provide comprehensive compliance oversight, risk assessment, auditing, and regulatory reporting, ensuring transparency and accountability at every level. Our work with agencies such as DSS, OTDA, and DOHMH reinforces our reputation as a trusted partner in maintaining ethical and operational standards.

Through our business consulting, cost reduction, and strategic development services, CLC supports organizations in achieving operational excellence and procurement readiness. We assist with certifications, proposal development, bid preparation, vendor registration (SAM.gov, PASSPort, DSBS, SFS), and logistics management. Our consultants also guide clients in supply chain optimization, expense management, and financial strategy, driving efficiency and sustainability across all business operations.

CLC’s commitment to training, education, and capacity building further empowers MWBEs, nonprofits, and community-based organizations. We design and deliver custom training programs focused on compliance, leadership, workforce development, and procurement readiness — equipping our partners with the tools to compete effectively in government and private contracting arenas.

At its core, Carter Lard Consulting’s mission extends beyond business. We collaborate with community organizations, social enterprises, and workforce initiatives to revitalize underserved neighborhoods through fair employment, economic inclusion, and equitable access to opportunity. By integrating staffing, housing, compliance, and social service expertise, CLC creates sustainable pathways for communities to thrive socially, environmentally, and economically.

Cassie Chris LLC: Where Art Meets Film & TV

Cassie Chris LLC, led by visionary artist and writer Cassie Chris, is a Black woman-owned business deeply rooted in Brooklyn, New York. With over a decade of experience, we specialize in blending the worlds of art, film, and TV, bringing a unique and innovative approach to both industries. Our mission is to solve the challenges of creative storytelling and artistic integration, offering services that prioritize originality, quality, and cultural resonance.

Expertise and Services:

Film & TV Industry

Script Writing and Story Development: We craft compelling scripts and storylines that resonate with audiences across film, TV, and digital media, ensuring your project stands out.
Production Management: We handle every detail of production with precision, from pre-production planning to on-set coordination, ensuring a smooth process.
Character Design and Animation: Our expertise in both traditional and digital animation brings visually stunning, emotionally engaging characters to life.

Arts & Crafts

Realistic Figure Sculptures: We create life-like sculptures that add depth to any space, ideal for public installations, private collections, or as props.
Sculptural Installations: Our large-scale installations transform spaces, creating immersive environments that evoke emotion and reflect the community.
Ceramic Art for Architectural Integration: We design custom ceramic tiles and sculpted pieces that seamlessly integrate into architectural projects, adding an artistic touch.
Outdoor Ceramic Art: Our durable ceramic pieces are perfect for outdoor installations, enhancing gardens, parks, and urban landscapes.
Illustrations: Our illustration services bring a unique visual flair to your projects, whether for print, digital media, or custom artwork.
Teaching and Mentorship:
With over seven years of experience as a teaching artist, we offer workshops and mentorship programs that inspire and educate the next generation of artists across disciplines like animation, sculpture, and creative storytelling.

Problem-Solving Through Creativity:
We understand the challenges of creating unique and personalized spaces, as well as the complexities of storytelling in the film and TV industry. By integrating high-quality craftsmanship, innovative design, and culturally resonant narratives, we ensure your vision is brought to life with precision and creativity.

Our Commitment
Cassie Chris LLC is more than just a business; it's a collaborative partner for those seeking to infuse their projects with creativity, culture, and quality. We pride ourselves on our attention to detail, adaptability to various artistic styles, and commitment to delivering exceptional results.

Our Background
Cassie Chris, the founder of Cassie Chris LLC, is a first-generation Haitian-American multidisciplinary artist and writer with a rich background in both the arts and the film and TV industry. With over 10 years of experience, Cassie has collaborated with fashion stylists, directed creative projects, and developed a wide range of skills in sculpture, animation, and digital arts. Her work has been featured in Fashion Magazine, YouTube series, New York Fashion Shows, and more.

In addition to her artistic practice, Cassie has spent over seven years mentoring young artists in New York City, teaching them the fundamentals of animation, sculpture, and creative expression. Her passion for storytelling and dedication to artistic excellence make her a valuable partner in any project.

Contact Us:
If you're looking to enhance your project with unique art, compelling narratives, and high-quality craftsmanship, Cassie Chris LLC is here to help. Let's collaborate to create something truly extraordinary that resonates with your audience and stands the test of time.

business_description:
Led by Architect Ceren Bingol, AIA, LEEDap, Ceren Bingol Studio is a small practice with project based collaborators. It is a cross-disciplinary environment where aesthetic, social, economic and environmental considerations meet architectural thinking to imagine and deliver projects at multiple scales: architecture, urbanism, interiors and products. The spirit of innovative creation, curiosity and the goal of enhancing people's daily lives drive Ceren Bingol Studio to constantly search for ways to incorporate the joy of life and creativity into the practice’s projects. 

Ceren is a licensed architect with 18 years of experience in some of the world’s leading architecture practices such as OMA founded by Rem Koolhaas, Grimshaw Architects founded Sir Nicholas Grimshaw and Robert A.M. Stern Architects. In 2016, she founded Ceren Bingol Studio, where she has designed and delivered a number of projects that have been widely published. Previously, Ceren worked as a senior architect and project manager at OMA New York where she led the design and construction of cultural projects such as, Quebec National Museum of Beaux-Arts, Marina Abramovic Performance Arts Center and Albright Knox Gallery Extension.  Prior to OMA, Ceren worked at Grimshaw Architects on high profile projects all of which exhibit exquisite attention to detail, building systems and sustainable design, such as Queens Museum of Art and Fulton Street Transit Center.

Ceren is also an academic and educator. From 2016-2018, she was the Architect-in-Residence and Director of Architecture Department at Cranbrook Academy of Art, where she mentored 15 thesis student and critiqued the work of over 100 students in the various MFA programs, took over student recruiting, started new programs such as Cranbrook Architecture Lecture Series, Cranbrook Architecture and Urban Design Project Incubator and various collaborations between the Academy’s students and the City of Detroit Planning Department. Since 2018, she is an Adjunct Associate Professor at The Cooper Union, teaching design studio,  seminars in Advanced Concepts in architecture and phenomenology of space and mentoring thesis students.

Ceren has  continually imagined avenues to create alternative platforms for infusing cities with thought-provoking events that engage city dwellers in dialogue with the cutting-edge trends and practitioners in architecture, art, design and cultural practice.  Two such pioneering organizations she brought to life in the capacities of conceptual creator, organizer and curator include the Imagination of Space on Governors Island, a 5-month long art space and residency celebrating imagination in space, cities, ecology, form, light, sound and material through spatially immersive works, and The Drop: Urban Art Infill, of 2009, a festival of public interactive art, music and fashion projects, creating an actual participatory semi-utopia of arts on a closed to traffic block in the middle of the city.  Both events have brought together a diverse range of established and emerging cultural participants such as Yoko Ono and Paul D. Miller among 50+ others vibrantly juxtaposed next to cutting-edge design, sound and performance.

business_description:
Chance Compliance & Investigations LLC is a fully licensed, bonded, and insured private investigation and compliance firm headquartered in New York, dedicated to providing discreet, results-driven investigative services with the highest standards of professionalism, accuracy, and integrity. As a minority-owned business enterprise (MBE), Chance CNI is committed not only to delivering exceptional investigative results but also to promoting ethical business practices, community safety, and corporate responsibility. Our firm specializes in a wide array of investigative services including insurance fraud investigations, workers’ compensation surveillance, civil litigation support, corporate due diligence, pre-employment background checks, activity checks, social media investigations, claimant interviews, recorded statements, and domestic-related inquiries such as infidelity and cohabitation surveillance. Each case is handled with precision, discretion, and a deep understanding of New York’s legal and regulatory landscape. We support law firms, insurance carriers, third-party administrators, self-insured entities, municipalities, government agencies, and private clients with timely, detailed, and court-admissible reporting.

Our investigators bring backgrounds in law enforcement, military intelligence, and legal support services, ensuring an approach that is both tactical and compliant with local, state, and federal regulations. We leverage state-of-the-art surveillance equipment, GPS tracking (when legally permissible), drone reconnaissance (FAA-compliant), and social media analysis tools to capture critical evidence and behavioral patterns. Our operations division is capable of conducting long-term surveillance, multi-state investigations, and rush assignments while maintaining high levels of documentation and chain-of-custody standards. In the digital space, our team performs comprehensive cyber investigations, social media footprint reviews, and OSINT collection to identify red flags, verify identities, and uncover undisclosed relationships or activities. Our commitment to operational excellence includes meticulous reporting, HD-quality video capture, detailed time-stamped logs, and consistent client communication throughout each assignment. All investigative reports are formatted to meet the evidentiary standards of civil courts, arbitrations, and administrative hearings.

In addition to surveillance and fraud work, Chance Compliance & Investigations is actively building a robust compliance and security services division designed to meet the growing needs of corporate, public-sector, and nonprofit clients. This includes security guard licensing, compliance monitoring, risk assessments, vendor due diligence, and incident response support. Our internal compliance team ensures that all investigative activities are conducted within the boundaries of applicable laws including FCRA, HIPAA, GINA, and the New York State General Business Law governing private investigators. We are prequalified for government contracting opportunities and have submitted proposals across multiple agencies including transit authorities, school construction authorities, and municipal insurance programs. We are also experienced in fulfilling MWBE participation requirements as a certified NYS MBE, offering partner firms and prime contractors a trusted investigative partner capable of meeting diversity goals while delivering best-in-class services.

Our clients choose Chance CNI because of our responsiveness, adaptability, and results-focused approach. We understand the urgent nature of most investigative matters and work within tight timelines without sacrificing quality. Every client is assigned a dedicated case manager who remains accessible throughout the investigation and serves as a single point of contact for updates, deliverables, and final reporting. We also provide secure evidence transfers, digital portals for real-time updates, and password-protected case files to maintain confidentiality. From field surveillance in dense urban neighborhoods to witness location and interviews in remote areas, our team maintains full geographic coverage throughout New York City’s five boroughs, Long Island, Westchester, and neighboring counties, with the capacity to expand to multi-jurisdictional cases as needed.

At our core, Chance Compliance & Investigations is driven by a belief that truth, transparency, and trust are foundational to any successful investigative relationship. Whether uncovering fraudulent claims, protecting organizational assets, or delivering peace of mind to a concerned individual, our firm remains focused on ethical execution, factual clarity, and actionable intelligence. Our reputation is built on consistent delivery, detailed documentation, and a track record of results that speak for themselves.

Established in 2012, ClearlyEnergy specializes in climate policy analysis, climate program management, and software development. ClearlyEnergy, an 80% women-owned certified small business, works at the nexus of public policy and software solutions using data-driven analytics and reporting to enable the energy transition. We are uniquely qualified to facilitate residential and commercial building energy programs through personalized policy development and implementation support. Our projects include benchmarking and building performance standards, carbon accounting and disclosure, energy-efficient mortgages, virtual residential audits, and automated energy models. ClearlyEnergy’s suite of software solutions are designed to facilitate emissions reduction programs in a streamlined and equitable manner.

Residential
ClearlyEnergy works with community partners to add transparency to home energy costs and manage both voluntary and compliance residential energy disclosure programs. ClearlyEnergy developed the Automated Energy Model and the Remotely app to help homeowners complete and review a residential energy audit of their home.  This information helps the current, or future, homeowners understand their home’s energy costs, consumption, and emissions and can help lenders screen candidate homes for energy mortgages. 

Commercial
ClearlyEnergy is a thought leader in the field of building performance standards. Our proprietary software, Building Energy Analysis Manager (BEAM), aggregates benchmarking data and performs automatic compliance tracking based on a jurisdiction's specific benchmarking or building performance standards policy. BEAM was developed by leveraging partnerships with the EPA, DOE, and National Labs to ensure we created a forward-thinking energy solution. BEAM is used by a diverse selection of state and local jurisdictions across the country that range in size, bandwidth, and implementation starting points. 

Targeted Projects
ClearlyEnergy uses its skills and capabilities with software development, energy modeling, stakeholder engagement, training, research and analysis, program management, and technical assistance to support states, jurisdictions, and organizations in their targeted energy efficiency projects and policy development and implementation. Examples of specific projects include supporting West Virginia in the creation of an inter-agency energy and water use data communication tool; supporting Cambridge, MA in tracking building compliance towards their goal of achieving carbon neutrality in buildings; developing and maintaining, for Northeast Energy Efficiency Partnerships (NEEP), the Home Energy Labeling Information eXchange (HELIX) database that populates real estate listings with home energy information; developing the software for NEEP’s Cold Climate Air Source Heat Pump List (ASHP) and supplemental sizing and visualization tools; and providing energy burden analyses and greenhouse gas disclosure to financial institutions to support residential loans.

business_description:
CO Adaptive Architecture was founded in 2011 in New York City by Ruth Mandl and Bobby Johnston. Amidst an industry that is highly predicated on the finished image of architecture, we want to turn the focus to the means of making and maintaining it. We believe it is our responsibility as architects to understand the design of one building as part of a holistic system whose component parts have an effect on the environment they sit within. We specialize in retrofitting existing building stock to create energy-efficient and climate-resilient environments, with the goal of extending the lifespans of these buildings for many decades to come. We feel this is not only the best way to celebrate our cities’ history, but also to minimize our collective carbon footprint.
When retrofitting, we are passionate about creating quiet, comfortable and high-performance interiors, ensuring that the building is not using more energy than it can produce on site. We are attentive to the durability, health and embodied energy of materials that we use; consciously specifying materials that are local in origin, and store carbon rather than emit it in their making. It matters that materials are as simple as possible in their constitution and are produced without harm to the environment or the people making them. In our mind, care for the parts translates to a healthy whole. As such, our practice places importance on those aspects generally hidden from view in a finished project, emphasizing the past and future journeys of the ingredients as they come together. Often, the best materials to use are those that already exist. To that end, we accentuate local reuse in our projects, reintegrating and reviving found elements of the buildings we renovate.
We are strong believers that architecture is a process rather than an end result; it should be a collaborative practice that works to solve today’s biggest challenges—and does this by building upon the past rather than reinventing it.

CO Adaptive has won numerous awards for their work, and been recognized as a Design Vanguard by Architectural Record, featured as a Next Progressive by ARCHITECT Magazine, and is show-cased in the inaugural exhibition Architecture Now: New York, New Publics at The Museum of Modern Art, which was on view from February through July 2023.

business_description:
Curtis + Ginsberg Architects LLP (C+GA) is an award-winning architecture and planning firm whose work focuses on serving the needs of our clients, the community, and the environment. The firm was founded in 1990 by Roberta Darby Curtis, AIA, and Mark Ginsberg, FAIA, LEED AP, on the belief that everyone deserves access to quality design and that design can effect positive change for individuals and communities. C+GA is a certified women-owned business (WBE).

Whether the project is a new building, a rehabilitation, or a planning study, C+GA helps each client realize a design that enables them to serve their mission. We are committed to ensuring that each project serves its immediate users and its surrounding community. 

C+GA has completed a wide range of residential, commercial, academic, and cultural projects for public, private, and not-for-profit organizations. The firm is a recognized expert in the design of sustainable mixed-use, multifamily and supportive housing and institutional projects. The firm is a recognized expert in the design of sustainable multi-family affordable and supportive housing. Our expertise in new construction and the rehabilitation of existing buildings has resulted in the completion of over 20,000 individual units in New York, with approximately 1,800 new and the transformation of 3,000 existing units currently in various stages of design. Central to this work is a belief that people deserve to live, work, and play in well-designed, dignified, and comfortable spaces. 

Our thoughtful design process places special emphasis on analyzing the client’s goals site, program, and budget, to create a design solution that serves the needs of the client and the project’s users, while also considering the broader community and environmental impact. Each project begins with a conversation that continues throughout the design process. We listen carefully to the client and stakeholders to understand their priorities and concerns to create the best possible project. We avidly pursue design excellence, and our work reflects our commitment to quality.

Central to all our work is a commitment to developing social and environmental resilience in the communities in which we work. C+GA has been pivotal in designing for sustainability and resiliency since its founding, not just in green design but also developing enduring schemes that strengthen communities and neighborhoods. Our research and technical expertise in this area is carried through to all our work, whether certified or not. We have completed numerous LEED projects, over 60 buildings in the Enterprise Green Communities program, and are a leader in Passive House (PHIUS and iPHA) certified design, with over 19 Passive House projects in New York City. Our leadership in sustainable design is recognized locally and nationally, ranking in the Engineering News-Record’s (ENR) 2022 Top 100 Green Design Firms, and we were selected for the 2021 Ivory Prize Innovation in Sustainable Housing. In addition, we have taken a lead role in the architecture community’s resiliency efforts following Hurricane Sandy, working with municipalities, public agencies, developers, and civic groups to build more resilient communities. 

The C+GA team is structured to ensure that each client receives the most professional and personalized service possible. Our collaborative and communication-forward ethos strives to advance design excellence while advancing social and environmental resilience.

We focus on teaching school and district leaders how to move beyond traditional top-down, compliance management methods which have been shown to lead to conflict, quiet quitting, and bias. The approach uses the Kaleidoscope Method, where teams engage in an inquiry-based effort to collect team data, identify points of intervention, set goals, and then work together to achieve those goals. 

3. Research and Communications – This program supports leaders in conducting research to identify what’s working and what’s not in terms of team dynamics. This includes 360 assessments, culture surveys, program evaluation, and other methods. We then work with the leaders to share the information in ways that get senior leaders and employees lit on fire to create change.

We offer a safe, confidential space where leaders can reflect on their performance, explore their strengths, and work through obstacles that may be holding them back. Through guided introspection and actionable feedback, we partner with clients to break through these barriers, allowing them to lead with greater confidence, clarity, and impact.

In addition to one-on-one coaching, we also offer organizational leadership development programs. Whether through group coaching sessions, leadership workshops, or initiatives to build internal coaching capabilities, we partner with organizations to strengthen their leadership pipeline and foster a culture of continuous growth and development. We understand the dynamics of organizational success and the importance of aligning leadership development with broader business objectives, which allows us to design impactful programs that drive lasting change.

A cornerstone of our business is the 90-day executive leadership coaching program, specifically designed to support new leaders as they transition into executive positions. Throughout the 90-day program we emphasize the importance of leveraging internal resources, ensuring that leaders have a support system in place to maximize their impact and sustain their success long-term.

Our approach to coaching is both practical and insightful. We guide leaders through difficult decisions, help them cultivate self-awareness, and push them to take ownership of their growth. The coaching relationship is built on trust and collaboration, with an emphasis on achieving specific, measurable outcomes. By focusing on tangible results, we ensure that clients not only develop as leaders but also deliver meaningful contributions to their organizations.

Moreover, our focus on integrating internal coaching skills within organizations highlights the long-term value DSCCG provides. Businesses recognize the importance of creating an internal coaching culture, training leaders to support each other, and embedding continuous development as part of the organizational fabric. This approach ensures that leadership growth is sustainable and that coaching benefits extend beyond individual sessions into the organization's day-to-day practices. 

Ultimately, the DS Coaching & Consulting Group is the trusted partner for leaders and organizations seeking to enhance their leadership capabilities and drive long-term success.

We all do our best learning when we feel seen, connected and valued; the experience of belonging drives students’ academic success. Circle Up Learning offers an experiential model for school staff, which considers belonging a practice we can learn and we can teach.  

Founder, Liz Howort, has facilitated and coached school staff for over 5 years across the 5 boroughs. In her prior life, Liz was the founding Director of the Bard Early College Academy (NYC), an academic enrichment program for middle school students. She also taught 9th grade ELA and supported learning in resource room for many years in District One. Raised by public school teachers, Liz witnessed how educators can uplift one another as they face a system that does not prioritize well-being. This insight led Liz to center social emotional learning (SEL) in her coaching work; she sustains teams by celebrating successes, finding strength in the collective, and co-planning to increase belonging. Liz brings an equity lens to all of her work, and has dived deep into racial equity and disability and inclusion. Liz is also passionate about personal storytelling, creative practices, and healing in community. Outside of school, she enjoys hikes, bikes and gardening with her family.  

Liz earned her BA and MAT from Bard College and her MFA from the New School University.

Elle Rouge LLC is a certified Minority and Women-Owned Business Enterprise (MWBE) providing innovative solutions in digital storytelling, social media strategy, professional development, and event production with a focus on educational institutions and community organizations. Our work centers on helping schools, districts, and nonprofits strengthen their digital voice, authentically tell their stories, and deepen trust with families and communities. With over two decades of combined expertise in events, marketing, branding, and content creation, Elle Rouge brings a unique blend of creativity, cultural responsiveness, and technical skill to every engagement.

Our social media storytelling services help schools develop strategies that highlight student achievement, school culture, and community partnerships. We design content tailored for platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and YouTube, producing branded visuals, short-form videos, and campaigns that capture authentic moments and build family engagement. We also provide content calendars, social media audits, and performance analytics that help schools translate online visibility into stronger connections with their communities.

In addition to digital storytelling, Elle Rouge LLC offers full-scale support for virtual and hybrid event production. From conferences and professional development days to parent workshops, town halls, and student showcases, we provide event branding, platform management, live streaming, registration systems, and post-event reporting. These services allow schools and districts to extend their reach, increase participation, and ensure events reflect the professionalism and pride of their communities.

Recognizing the growing need for capacity building within schools, we design and deliver professional development tailored to Parent Coordinators, Community School Directors, and school staff who oversee digital communications. Our trainings are hands-on and practical, covering how to capture privacy-safe but powerful content, take engaging photos and short videos, create posts that “stop the scroll,” and integrate AI tools that make content creation faster and more consistent. We also provide customized toolkits, such as the Respect & Trust Messaging Toolkit, which equips schools with editable Canva templates for back-to-school messages, holiday greetings, and parent engagement reminders.

Elle Rouge LLC also supports family and community engagement campaigns that go beyond traditional methods of communication. We design bilingual and culturally responsive messaging strategies that reflect the identity of the school community and amplify student voices. Our storytelling approach strengthens family trust, increases transparency, and ensures that the values of the school are consistently represented. Beyond staff training, we also connect this work to workforce readiness by introducing students to digital storytelling as a viable career pathway aligned with Career and Technical Education (CTE).

Our proven impact can be seen in partnerships with the New York City Department of Education Office of Community Schools, Village Academy, Bronx Community Schools, and PS 287 Global Innovators. Through these collaborations, schools have reported measurable increases in family engagement, stronger alignment between digital presence and school culture, and significant growth in online reach. For example, campaigns we designed have consistently delivered engagement rates well above industry benchmarks, showing how effective storytelling can transform school-to-family communication.

Led by a former NYC DOE Parent Coordinator who supported a successful “turnaround” school, Elle Rouge LLC combines deep knowledge of school systems with professional expertise in branding and digital engagement. This perspective allows us to understand the challenges school leaders face while providing strategies that are practical, sustainable, and impactful.

Elle Rouge LLC remains committed to helping educational institutions and community organizations harness the power of digital platforms to tell their stories, build trust, and strengthen the relationships that support student success. As an MWBE-certified company, we continue to expand our services and impact while maintaining the highest standards of accountability and cultural competence.

We enhance customer satisfaction and foster positive brand experiences by bridging language barriers.

In a city as dynamic as New York, real-time interpretation is vital for effective communication in various scenarios. FCI offers professional interpretation services, including simultaneous, consecutive, and remote interpretation, to facilitate seamless communication in business meetings, conferences, legal proceedings, healthcare settings, and more. Our qualified interpreters ensure accurate and confidential communication between individuals who speak different languages.

Our experienced linguists are well-versed in working with government agencies, ensuring compliance with regulations, and delivering high-quality translations of legal documents, public notices, community outreach materials, and more.

Educational Support:
New York City's educational landscape is enriched by its diverse student population. FCI can contribute to inclusive learning environments by providing translation and interpretation services for schools, colleges, and educational institutions. We assist in translating educational materials, supporting parent-teacher conferences, facilitating communication with non-English-speaking students and their families, and more.

With our commitment to ISO 9001 compliance, stringent quality control processes, and a vast network of qualified language professionals, FCI is well-positioned to serve the language needs of New York City. Our mission is to bridge the communication gaps and promote inclusivity across diverse communities, enabling businesses, organizations, and individuals to thrive in this vibrant city.

For more information on how FCI – The Language Experts can support language services in New York City, please visit our website at [www.fcitle.com]. We would be delighted to discuss your specific requirements and provide tailored solutions for your linguistic needs.

business_description:
Fix It With Piggy is the Bronx’s only full-service community tech hub, providing both high-quality technology services and accessible tech education for youth, adults, and local organizations. Founded by Ashonda Culcleasure, Fix It With Piggy was created to close the digital divide in underserved communities by offering a safe, vibrant, and culturally responsive space where people of all ages can learn, work, and engage with technology confidently.

We operate as a hybrid service and education model. Our tech service department offers device diagnostics, hardware repair, software troubleshooting, data recovery, website development, and on-demand tech support for individuals, families, and small businesses. These services provide reliable, affordable solutions for community members who often lack access to trustworthy tech repair options. Revenue from services directly funds our educational programming and workforce development opportunities.

Our education division delivers hands-on, project-based learning through after-school programs, weekend workshops, summer internships, and adult digital literacy classes. Students learn skills such as computer repair, coding, web design, digital creativity, and AI fluency—skills that translate into confidence, academic improvement, and career readiness. Many of our youth participants leave with certificates, completed digital projects, laptops, mentorship, and pathways toward employment. Our programs are intentionally designed to uplift Bronx youth by providing exposure to STEM, 21st-century job skills, and real-world tech experience.

Fix It With Piggy also serves local schools, nonprofits, and community centers through partnerships that deliver tech curriculum, teacher professional development, and on-site tech support. Our commitment to community advancement extends to job creation; we regularly hire interns, high school seniors, and college students, offering paid work experiences that help them build professional portfolios and secure future employment.

At the core of our mission is the belief that technology should be empowering, not intimidating or inaccessible. Fix It With Piggy transforms learning by making tech fun, hands-on, and culturally connected, while simultaneously solving everyday tech problems for the neighborhood. What began as a mission-driven startup has grown into a trusted Bronx institution dedicated to digital equity, economic mobility, and community innovation.

Fix It With Piggy is preparing to launch its first full community tech hub space, located inside the historic Andrew Freedman Home. The space will operate as a tech café, training center, repair shop, and creative studio, offering youth and adults a place to learn, build, repair, collaborate, and earn.

Our long-term vision is to build a replicable model of community-based tech empowerment across New York City and beyond—bridging digital gaps while cultivating the next generation of tech talent right here in the Bronx.

Talent Development & Recruitment: We identify and cultivate emerging gaming talent, offering pathways into local tournaments, professional scenes, and digital entrepreneurship.

GameGlory also champions equity and representation in esports. We center Black and Brown gamers, foster gender inclusion, and collaborate with mission-aligned partners to ensure accessibility. Whether it's hosting a tournament, co-producing a music-and-gaming showcase, or delivering career exposure workshops, we intentionally build spaces where culture, competition, and community collide.

Looking ahead, GameGlory is poised to scale our league model into new cities, partner with more gaming lounges and CBOs, and integrate web-based tools for broader reach. We’re also actively developing sponsorship opportunities and industry partnerships to fuel our next stage of growth.

GameGlory is where gamers compete, grow, and evolve. Our vision is clear: to make competitive gaming a launchpad for life success—both on and off the screen.

business_description:
Founded in the wake of personal tragedy, Healing Inc. is not just a business but a beacon of hope, healing, and empowerment. The journey began after our founder, Isabel, experienced the heartbreaking loss of her brother to suicide. Faced with the overwhelming grief that comes from losing a loved one, Isabel found herself on a mission to spread awareness about mental health and the importance of self-care. It was during this period of reflection and healing that Healing Inc. was born—a company dedicated to promoting mental health awareness and providing an avenue for self-expression and self-care through the art of candle making.
At the core of Healing Inc. is a mission to spread mental health awareness and promote the practice of self-care. While candles are often seen as simple objects that add ambiance to a room, Healing Inc. has reimagined them as vessels for healing. Each candle-making workshop we conduct is an opportunity to not only craft a beautiful product but also to learn valuable lessons about mindfulness, self-compassion, and emotional well-being.

Our workshops are thoughtfully designed to blend creative expression with education about mental health. Each session provides participants with mental health tips, guidance on practicing self-care, and moments of introspection. Whether it’s discussing the importance of rest, sharing techniques for reducing anxiety, or simply holding space for individuals to talk about their mental health struggles, Healing Inc.’s workshops serve as a safe, supportive environment for healing and connection. Additionally, a portion of the proceeds from our candle sales go towards supporting suicide prevention programs and mental health organizations. By fostering these partnerships, we aim to create lasting change, helping individuals and communities as they navigate their mental health journeys.

business_description:
High Maintenance NY, Inc. is owned and operated by Vanessa Despot Rippere and is a Leed certified, QEWI, QPSI, QRWI firm. As a NYS Registered Architect and QEWI, Ms. Rippere leads the NYC FISP Team and Parking Structures Team, Professional Engineer included, to help Owners and Property Managers stay in compliance with New York City’s Local Laws.

We are your EXPERTS in:
• NYC FISP (formerly known as Local Law 11 (LL11/98)
The Facade Inspection & Safety Program (FISP), formerly known as LL11, requires periodic assessment of all buildings higher than 6 stories. All exterior walls and appurtenances must be  inspected every five years as per NYC's building code and new façade rules in effect. A QEWI is either a Registered Architect or Professional Engineer who has been interviewed and approved by the Department of Buildings (DOB). As a QEWI, we provide all related FISP services and prepare the required Technical Report (TR6). In addition, physical close-up inspections must be performed no more than 60’ apart at facades fronting the public right of way. If the building has a cavity wall, at least 1 probe must be done at each drop (inspection done from the ground to the top of the exterior wall) to inspect the presence and condition of the wall ties. The remaining facades must also be inspected, but does not require this physical close-up inspection. At High Maintenance NY, we can perform an entire façade inspection in just one day via IRA (industrial rope access) because it’s faster to mobilize/demobilize and relocate drops throughout the façade. It also helps that our FISP team has the experience and dedication to get the job done!

• PARKING STRUCTURES - Local Law 126 (LL126/21)
LL126 requires periodic assessment of all parking structures within the five boroughs of New York City every six years to ensure that they’re maintained in a safe condition. Owners are responsible for the proper inspection, repair, and maintenance of their parking structures, which must be examined by a Qualified Parking Structure Inspector (QPSI), and a report filed with the DOB. As a QPSI, we inspect these parking structures with a very thoughtful approach. It can be a small garage or a very large, multilevel garage that requires a thorough and efficient inspection approach. We then take all this visual data and transfer it into an easy to read report that is convenient to our Clients.  

• RETAINING WALLS - Local Law 37/08 (LL37/08)
LL37/08 requires owners of properties with a retaining wall or part of a retaining wall, which is at least ten feet high and faces a public right of way (including sidewalks or entrances), to have a condition assessment completed every five years. They must also file an assessment report (TR16) submitted to the Department of Buildings by a Professional Engineer (PE), who has a minimum of three years of relevant experience and is also an approved Qualified Retaining Wall Inspectors (QRWI). We have noticed that these retaining walls have fallen into disrepair due to the lack of maintenance. We advise our Clients how to repair them in a cost effective and minimally invasive manner.
 
High Maintenance NY Services:
We work with Clients both in the private and public sector, from a small building to a large development. business_description:
Immanuel INC has been operating since July 2010.  Immanuel INC complies fully with all federal, state, and local mandates, is fully accredited by NYC DOHMH Bureau of Day Care and follows all Pre-K practices set by the NYC DOE. Immanuel has been operating throughout the years. Our program provides day care services to low income, working, and new immigrant families in the communities. We have gradually served a growing diverse community and had to provide for more languages. Many of our families start their child’s educational journey in our 2-year-old class and continue to rise with the classes until they have completed Pre-K for All at our school. Our staff also sees the growth in the children and establish a trusting relationship with the families, which becomes extremely beneficial for the child’s overall development. We can provide more individual guidance to ensure that the child is being supported from our staff and at home. During our summer program, we offer a class for elementary grade students, which consists mostly of our program graduates. Our experience has allowed us to try to accommodate our families by providing for them the care, high-quality education, and positive school experience for their child.

The program goal for Immanuel is to teach to the whole child to their individual interests while equipping them with the tools to be respectful human beings that are intelligent and kind. We use the PKFCC to teach to the domains of learning, as well as introduce different cultures incorporating respect for our likenesses and differences.  We celebrate our families’ cultures and introduce the cultures of others. Immanuel has an “open-door” policy welcoming parents to partake in the child’s classroom. Additionally, we guide and support our families via email, articles, workshops, newsletters, and conferences. Immanuel staff is comprised of many cultures and serves a diverse community - particularly an Asian population.  We offer translation services and extended hours to accommodate working families and build a stronger partnership with our community. By combining the socioeconomic backgrounds of our families with the services our program offers, we continue to build upon a high valued partnership. We see this socioeconomic and racially diverse integrated classroom as an important component of preschool quality. It is our hope and goal to unite the family community with the school community in working together to bring forth culturally aware, kind and learned individuals. 

Our program serves the working and new immigrant families of Northeast Queens. What makes our program a good fit for this neighborhood is the high percentage of the Asian population living in the area, mostly consisting of Korean and Chinese families. Among these families, many of them are foreign born immigrants whose native language is not English; many of them require language assistance with important information and services, which may often be out of reach to immigrants. Many of our staff come from immigrant families themselves, which enables us to understand and relate to the community we serve. Our site is located conveniently among many public transportations stops, allowing families to drop-off and pick-up their child to and from work. Having a 10 hour per day service model helps our families be able to give their child a high-quality education, while working. Our site is located two blocks from the Long Island Railroad and an MTA bus stop is around the corner, making it very accessible for parents who rely on public transportation. Based on the estimated service need for zip code 11361, there is a high demand for a longer school day. To best help these families, our site is open from 7:30am to 6pm. To ensure the health and safety of our students, we adhere to all the requirements of Article 47 of the NYC DOHMH, NYC Department of Buildings, NYC DOE, and NYC Fire Inspections. Documentation of compliance with these regulations are always maintained on file. Precautions are also taken to eliminate all conditions in areas accessible to children that pose a safety or health hazard. We also comply with the policies described in the DECE handbook and our contract. Our staff is trained in health and other emergencies, such as First Aid/CPR – including Epi-Pen usage – fire fitness, and Food Protection licenses. All new and current staff are also trained annually through our Staff Handbook on how to respond to emergencies, behavior management, how to make mandated reports, and have established a team for Lost Child Prevention Policies and Procedures. We have made it mandatory for all our students and staff to receive all required vaccinations and immunizations, updated annually. All our meals are provided following the nutrition guidelines of CACFP, which is free for all families. Our school has also become a nut-free zone to accommodate our students with severe allergies.

Inclusive Communication Services (ICS) is dedicated to providing professional-quality accessibility services that cater to the diverse communication needs of individuals who are Deaf, hard-of-hearing, DeafBlind, blind, low-vision, non-English speaking, and limited English proficient (LEP). Each service request is managed by a designated accessibility coordinator with extensive professional expertise in accessibility, ensuring top-quality service delivery. Our comprehensive suite of services includes:

**Sign Language Interpreting**: We offer a wide range of sign language interpreting services to bridge communication gaps for the Deaf and hard-of-hearing community. Our offerings include:
- American Sign Language (ASL)
- British Sign Language (BSL)
- Mexican Sign Language (LSM)
- French Sign Language (LSF)
- And over 50 other sign language varieties

**Spoken Language Interpreting**: Our spoken language interpreting services facilitate effective communication for non-English speaking and LEP individuals. We cover:
- Spanish
- French
- Mandarin Chinese
- Haitian Creole
- Vietnamese
- Arabic
- Bengali
- German
- Hindi
- Italian
- Japanese
- Korean
- Portuguese
- Russian
- Turkish
- Urdu
- And over 150 other languages.

**Document and Media Translation**: Ensuring accuracy and accessibility, we provide translation services for a variety of content types:
- Legal documents
- Video content
- Educational courses
- Articles
- Court evidence
- And more

**Live Captioning**: For real-time access to spoken content, our live captioning services include:
- Communication Access Realtime Translation (CART)
- TypeWell captioning

**Subtitling**: Enhance the accessibility of your video and audio content with our reliable and accurate subtitling services, available in over 200 languages.

**Voiceover & Dubbing**: Make your multimedia content accessible to non-English speakers through our professional quality voiceover and audio dubbing services.

**Audio Description (AD)**: Ensure your video content and live events are accessible to the blind and low-vision community with our detailed audio description services.

**Braille & Large Print Transcription**: We offer transcription and printing services to convert visual content, media, and documents into braille and large print formats, making them accessible to the blind and low-vision community.

Inclusive Communication Services is committed to fostering equal access and inclusion across all communities. Whether it's sign language interpreting for a medical appointment, real-time captioning for a webinar, or translating legal documents, we ensure that our services meet the highest standards of quality and accuracy. Contact us today to learn more about how we can support your accessibility needs and promote inclusive communication for all.

For beginners to intermediate level learners, podcasts of short-lengths such as "Learn Cantonese Daily," "Learn Mandarin Daily," and "Learn Taishanese Daily" are digestible and perfect to build new vocabulary and sentence structures. For intermediate and advanced learners, "Boba Break Cantonese," "Cantonese Diaspora," and "Taishanese Diaspora" provide grammar breakdown and spontaneous conversations. Other than audio content like podcasts, students also enjoy watching tutorial and vlog videos to bring their Chinese level to the next step as they review the transcript packages of Inspirlang’s media content.

Inspirlang also publishes accredited language instructional books such as "Learn to Speak Cantonese" 1&2, "Learn to Speak Mandarin 1," "Learn to Speak Taishanese 1," and "Journaling in Chinese." Each one of Inspirlang’s textbooks comes with a unique storyline to create organic conversions built by commonly used vocabulary and sentence structures to create a more fun learning experience.
