Irujo Inc. is an ISO 9001 and 17100 certified business specializing in translation and localization (adaptation for local audiences) of educational, technical, marketing, medical, corporate, and legal content into over 20 languages. Our expertise spans various published media, including digital, audiovisual and print formats, ensuring that content is tailored to resonate with global audiences.

We approach each project with a unique strategy, combining localization expertise, advanced language technologies, and computer-assisted translation (CAT) tools to maximize consistency, efficiency, and cost savings, particularly in large-scale projects with tight deadlines. Our process begins with a thorough understanding of the client’s needs, including the purpose, audience, and context of the translation. We collaborate with our clients to determine the best production approach—whether pure human translation, machine translation, or a blend of both—to meet their specific requirements and budget constraints.

In addition to translation, Irujo Inc. excels in desktop publishing, working directly within native authoring tools to ensure that localized documents retain their original design integrity. Our experienced desktop publishers handle the complexities of multilingual formatting, including text expansion, character encoding, and bidirectionality, adapting layouts to suit the target language and cultural context.

Irujo Inc. also specializes in eLearning localization. We localize a wide variety of eLearning content to enhance global training and education efforts, ensuring messages are conveyed effectively in the learner's native language. Our services support corporate training, compliance, safety, sales, product education, and more. Our comprehensive approach includes meticulous project planning, centralized project management, and the use of specialized eLearning and CAT tools, ensuring smooth integration of localized content. We partner with a global network of native-speaking linguists and professional voiceover talents to deliver content that reflects the nuances of the original, including tone, tempo, and cultural context. Our cultural adaptation services ensure terminology aligns with local regulations, and we provide guidance on adjusting visuals, colors, and other elements to suit the target audience.

Irujo Inc. also leverages Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Neural Machine Translation (NMT), a cutting-edge technology that significantly boosts productivity for large-scale translation projects. While NMT offers great efficiency, we assess each project individually to determine when and how to apply this technology. We integrate NMT with traditional CAT tools, Translation Memories, Term Bases, and Style Guides to enhance consistency and leverage historical translations effectively.

By combining advanced technology with human expertise, Irujo Inc. delivers high-quality, customized translations that meet the specific needs of our clients, optimizing workflows for unmatched speed and efficiency. Our commitment to quality and client satisfaction ensures that we bring significant value to every project, helping businesses communicate effectively across languages and cultures.

JayCity Enterprise has three separate programs it teaches to scholars ranging from grades 4- infinity. First, is our Scripted Content Development Program that teaches students how to turn their real- life experiences into a script and then transform that script into a short film. Active participation from students teaches them how to perform in front of the camera as actors, as well as behind the scenes producers. Second, is our Documentary program that serves scholars from grades 8 - infinity. The program's objective: Give students the general introduction to the art of storytelling by way of documentaries and visual arts. Third is our Anti- Gun Violence workshop that we created based off of our award winning documentary KILLING BEEF 'Gun VIolence in the Black Community' for our scholars from grades 8 - infinity. The Student will identify with the general effects of gun violence in underserved communities. The Student will identify with people personal encounters of gun violence and its personal effects. And the mindset that causes gun violence to permeate in underserve communities. The Trainee will identify with the history and conditions that exist in underserve communities that encourages gun violence and will become better equip in critical thinking to help reduce gun violence. All of our programs help scholars to enrich personal language, background knowledge, and vocabulary through reading and communicating with others.
 
With well over three decades of individual media experience under their belts, Samson and Tyese have produced more than 100 hours of television for some of the most reputable networks including NBC, PBS, BET, FOX, Netflix and more. Since the network premiere of Killing Beef, Rutgers University Center for Gun Violence Research has incorporated the documentary into their program curriculum.  
 
The success and reach of Killing Beef has truly put JayCity Enterprise on the map, not only a media conglomerate but as the destination for content actualization. Now, Samson and Tyese are even more passionate about not only building their slate but seeing projects through to distribution. Currently, they are focused on unscripted and scripted content dedicated to cultural commentary. 
 
Their mission of authentic, passionate storytelling is evident in all that they do, and they are focused on providing entertainment with heart and integrity that will impact audiences around the world!

business_description:
Jenn Miller Cribbs leads trainings and workshops that unlock the power of participants’ presence and voice, so they can advocate for their ideas with authority and facilitate productive dialogue in even the most charged circumstances. A nationally recognized expert in effective communication, Jenn has done this work with government agencies, corporations, nonprofits, community organizations, and schools, driving transformational initiatives of all sizes.

Jenn's work is rooted in the foundations of presence in our bodies, breath and voice. One half of that presence is the ability to be perceptive and responsive to what is actually happening around you. The other half is speaking and acting from a place of authenticity, in a way that is seen and heard by others as being authoritative, trustworthy, and open. This ability to be present is as primal as our survival instincts to fight, flee, or freeze, yet many of us remain stuck in a cycle of reactivity. When you learn to be truly present in conversation, it will unlock your ability to stay in dialogue and further the work you are seeking to do in the world, even with people with whom you profoundly disagree, revealing previously invisible paths forward in your work and relationships. 

Jenn is a Patsy Rodenburg Associate, and has worked closely with the legendary voice teacher for nearly 25 years, practicing her teachings on the foundations of presence in our bodies, breath, and voice. Her other influences include Resmaa Menakem, Iain McGilchrist, and Brene Brown. The tools and operating processes of Jenn’s trainings are based in her graduate work at the Columbia School of Social Work and her experience with Collective Impact models.
 
A member of SAG-AFTRA and AEA, Jenn has performed in theaters all over the country, played principal television and commercial roles, and served as a voice and Shakespeare coach on myriad productions and one-on-one with actors. Her performing arts experience grounds her teaching of presence and voice in warmups, techniques, and daily routines that result in the predictable ability to connect with one’s audience and draw them into conversation with the material and each other.
 
Jenn has a BA in Biology, Neuropsychology, and Communications from Wheaton College; an MFA in Acting and Directing from the University of Missouri-Kansas City; and a Masters in Social Enterprise Administration from the Columbia University School of Social Work. She was a Presidential Management Fellow, and won both the Rising Leader and Innovator of the Year Awards at the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development.
 
Jenn lives with her husband and two daughters in Brooklyn, NY.

business_description:
JPM Collections, LLC is a health technology company dedicated to increasing equitable representation of marginalized and underrepresented populations in research studies. Our mission is to bridge the gap between research organizations and individuals who have historically been excluded from or hesitant to participate in research, while breaking down misconceptions and stigma surrounding what research truly is.

We specialize in identifying, engaging, and supporting potential research participants by providing clear, transparent, and culturally sensitive education about research opportunities. Many individuals are interested in contributing to research but lack access, trust, or understanding of the process. JPM Collections, LLC addresses these barriers by serving as a trusted connector between communities and research organizations.

Through our outreach and participant engagement efforts, we connect qualified individuals to clinical trials, behavioral studies, and other research initiatives conducted by academic institutions, healthcare organizations, and research sponsors. By improving participant diversity, we help ensure that research findings are more accurate, inclusive, and reflective of real-world populations. This increased diversity strengthens the validity, reliability, and applicability of research outcomes.

JPM Collections, LLC is committed to ethical engagement and participant advocacy. We prioritize informed consent, respect, and transparency at every stage of the process. Our approach empowers individuals to make educated decisions about participation while ensuring that research organizations meet recruitment goals responsibly and effectively.

In addition to participant recruitment, we work closely with research teams to improve outreach strategies, communication, and community engagement. By leveraging technology and data-driven methods, we streamline the recruitment process while maintaining a strong human-centered focus. Our work supports faster enrollment timelines, reduced recruitment costs, and higher-quality participant matching.

At its core, JPM Collections, LLC believes that research should be inclusive, accessible, and beneficial to all communities. By challenging outdated perceptions and amplifying underrepresented voices, we help shape a more equitable research landscape—one where everyone has the opportunity to contribute to and benefit from scientific advancement.

KACE World, LLC, is a boutique, full-service firm that provides legal, DEI consulting, training and strategic planning services to government, businesses, and non-profit organizations.  We help you to create systems that will support your organizational growth, improve employee effectiveness, and foster a diverse, inclusive, and high-performance culture.

We help employers to mitigate potential legal liabilities which can arise from employee misconduct.  We provide on-site workshops and retreats, coaching, and training on a variety of subjects including racial, gender, religious, sexual orientation, or other biases and forms of discrimination. 

Our customized training seminars and workshops provide flexible solutions tailored to organizational needs that will develop each employee to their highest potential and train managers and supervisors on  strategies for achieving organizational goals in a manner that aligns with the needs and expectations of today’s workplace.  

Our professional services include, but are not limited to diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives; EEOC, disciplinary and administrative hearing representation; federal and state employment litigation, leadership training; executive coaching; and sexual harassment and hostile workplace intervention and training.

PROGRAMS

  DW Solutions - DEI Initiatives 

Our diversity, equity, and inclusion (“DEI”)  services are provided through our DW Solution Programs which include workshops, executive coaching, strategic planning, human resource training, and implementation of recruitment and retention policies that will unlock the power of diversity for your organization or business. 

In today’s world, it is important to combat conscious and unconscious bias in the workforce by helping employees better understand how to interact with their peers from diverse cultures or backgrounds. Program participants will gain increased cultural competency that will  improve their communication and team building skills to create a more effective and collaborative workplace. 

The average individual does not easily perceive their own innate biases and prejudices.  They may fail to understand how seemingly innocuous statements can be perceived as culturally insensitive microaggressions, which undercut the collegiality of the workplace.   Therefore, this important training will help employees understand the nuances of language and conduct in conveying conscious and unconscious biases, recognize the negative impact that these biases can have on others, and embrace strategies for sustainable behavioral change.

Our training programs are comprehensive and interactive. They can be presented on various platforms including in person workshops, charrettes, webinars, and online classes that participants complete at their own pace.  A charrette is a facilitated session which incorporates case studies and simulations to enable participants to recognize cultural factors which might impede the effectiveness of their work.  The training sessions also employ team imagining, as a training technique.
 
Our training Modules include but are not limited to: Understanding the Basics: Diversity & Inclusion in the Workplace; Microaggressions, Conscious and Unconscious Bias; Cultural Competency; DEI Recruitment and Retention Strategies; and EEOC & Affirmative Action policies that may your impact your business practices. 

  EEOC, Employee Disciplinary & Administrative Hearings

Our attorneys have successfully defended employers and conducted workplace investigations related to Equal Employment Opportunity Commission complaints, disciplinary hearings and NYC and NYS employment hearings for various administrative and government entities such as the City University of New York and the New York City Council. Our attorneys have significant state and federal employment litigation experience and are admitted in New York State and in the Southern and Eastern District Federal Courts.

  Sexual Harassment Training & Investigations

Sexual harassment is unwelcome conduct of a sexual nature that limits or interferes with an individual’s ability to participate in or fulfill their employment responsibilities. Employers are increasingly being held legally responsible for the sexual misconduct of their employees. Therefore it is important that this potential liability be mitigated through adequate training of staff on acceptable and unacceptable conduct, particularly where the workforce is comprised of  individuals from multiple generations, cultures, ethnicities, genders, and sexual orientations. 

  Leadership Training/Executive Coaching
Our consultants have over twenty years of experience in leadership training and executive coaching and hold certifications from the Academy of Management , International Coaching Federation, and the Public Relations Society of America.

The program emphasizes self-discovery, teamwork, and overcoming barriers, ensuring that every participant leaves with a stronger sense of self and purpose.

The Write Speak Inspire League (WSIL), Generation Verb’s signature competitive poetry league, adds an exciting dimension to the program. Students participate in team-based matches where they perform surrounded by a supportive audience. These competitions challenge students to refine their skills, build confidence under pressure, and celebrate the art of spoken word in a collaborative setting.

Ultimately, Generation Verb is more than a poetry program—a movement. It seeks to create a pipeline to great possibilities in professional performance, education, or other fields. By empowering students to express themselves responsibly and confidently, Generation Verb ensures its participants are prepared to lead, inspire, and achieve greatness in all they do.

Through its innovative approach to education and self-expression, Generation Verb continues to transform lives, one verse at a time.

business_description:
La Newyorkina is a woman-owned company founded by Mexico City native, James Beard-nominated pastry Chef Fany Gerson. Everything is handmade from scratch in small batches, using the best ingredients we can get our hands on, and we never use any artificial flavorings or colorings. We carefully source our ingredients and work closely with farmers in NY and nearby to get our delicious organic dairy, seasonal fruits, and herbs. Other ingredients that simply don’t grow or can’t be found around New York like the Mexican vanilla bean, Oaxacan chocolate, tamarind, some dried chiles, passion fruit and hibiscus are imported, but we spend a lot of time and care making sure we get the best ingredients available and work with small producers in Mexico as we believe it’s very important to support them as well.
From the beginning, we have been committed to social and environmental responsibility and continuously strive to become a waste-free company. We compost our scraps, use recycled containers and napkins, and source much of our packaging locally. We are also very proud to support a wonderful organization like Fundación Crea, No Kid Hungry, City Harvest, Edible Schoolyard, Meals on Wheels, amongst others, and donate a portion of our sales to them whenever possible.
Crea helps generate employment opportunities in Mexico for low-income women. These women are amazing and a continuous inspiration.
To put it simply, the heart and mission of La Newyorkina is to share the sweetness of México.

business_description:
Laurissa Jane Music Studio (LJMS) is a dedicated performing arts institution committed to providing children, youth, and adults with a strong, equitable foundation in music and the performing arts. Rooted in community engagement and artistic excellence, LJMS believes in the transformative power of arts education to build confidence, discipline, creativity, and lifelong skills.

LJMS proudly serves the vibrant communities of South Jamaica, St. Albans, Hollis, Queens Village, Rosedale, and Cambria Heights in Queens—areas where access to consistent, high-quality arts programming is often limited. To further remove geographic barriers, LJMS also offers live, interactive online instruction, allowing students in Brooklyn and beyond to participate fully in our programs. Through our virtual offerings, LJMS has successfully reached students as far as Oregon and Georgia, expanding access to arts education for families nationwide.

Through a team of experienced, professionally trained instructors, LJMS provides both private and group instruction, offered in person and online, in piano, voice, guitar, choral music, and musical theater. Instruction is available for students of all ages and skill levels, from early childhood beginners to teens and adults pursuing advanced musical goals. Lessons are designed to be sequential and developmentally appropriate, emphasizing technical proficiency, music literacy, ensemble skills, and expressive performance while fostering creativity and self-confidence.

LJMS places a strong emphasis on inclusive, student-centered learning environments. Group classes promote collaboration, teamwork, and peer learning, while private instruction allows for individualized goal-setting and personalized musical development. Across all programs, instructors integrate foundational musicianship, performance practice, and social-emotional learning, helping students build resilience, focus, and communication skills through the arts.

In addition to year-round music instruction, LJMS operates a Summer Musical Theatre Arts Program, which offers a dynamic, immersive creative environment for young people with a passion for acting, singing, and dancing. This multidisciplinary program integrates vocal performance, acting technique, movement, choreography, and ensemble collaboration. Students work together toward a culminating production, gaining firsthand experience in rehearsal processes, stage presence, and live performance while developing leadership and confidence in a supportive setting.

Recognizing the importance of formal music education and credentialing, LJMS offers year-round preparation for nationally and internationally recognized music assessments, including NYSSMA and ABRSM. Through structured coaching, repertoire development, and mock evaluations, students are supported in achieving measurable milestones that strengthen academic portfolios and artistic pathways.

Performance is a central component of LJMS programming. Students are provided with regular opportunities to perform in recitals, showcases, school partnerships, and community events, allowing them to apply their learning in real-world settings and engage families and community members in their artistic growth. These experiences reinforce confidence, accountability, and pride in achievement.

Grounded in the belief that the arts are essential—not optional—LJMS remains committed to expanding access to high-quality music and performing arts education. By combining in-person and online instruction, community-based partnerships, and performance-driven learning, Laurissa Jane Music Studio continues to nurture the next generation of expressive, skilled, and empowered artists while strengthening the cultural fabric of the communities it serves.

M&S Mechanical, LLC is a family owned and operated business, headquartered in Brooklyn, New York City. We serve all the five boroughs of New York City. Our technicians are experts at working with a wide range of different pipelines. We have worked in both large scale and medium to small scale projects.

We have vast experience working with all types of HVAC piping, from mechanical rooms, cooling towers, fuel oil pipes, condensate drains, and condenser, hot and cold water piping.

Our technicians have extensive knowledge and experience in the fields of pipe welding, structural welding, ship repair structure welding, methanol plant pipe welding and ammonia plant pipe welding. Further, we are versed in gas tungsten arc welding, gas metal arc welding, shielded metal arc welding and oxyacetylene welding. Chrome molly, carbon steel, stainless steel Monel alloy are among the metal types which our welders are versed at working with.

Our pipe fitters also have worked extensively with black pipes, copper pipes and copper tubing (for the latter two, doing both brazing and soldering). 

M&S MECHANICAL’S MISSION
Honesty, reliability and the highest quality of work as measured by customer satisfaction form the foundation of our business’ mission. The safety of our customers and their equipment and that of our staff is our priority. business_description:
Mapp Holdings LLC: Empowering Through Education, Art, and Therapy

Introduction

Mapp Holdings LLC is a dynamic and innovative company dedicated to transforming lives through education, empowerment speaking engagements, and artistic experiences. Founded on a vision of fostering personal growth, healing, and creativity, our organization is committed to equipping youth and adults with the tools they need to navigate life's challenges successfully. At Mapp Holdings LLC, we believe in the power of knowledge, art, and therapy to inspire positive change and empower individuals to lead fulfilling lives.

Our Mission

Our primary mission at Mapp Holdings LLC is to empower individuals, especially youth and adults, by providing them with essential life skills, knowledge, and therapeutic experiences. We aim to create safe and inclusive spaces where people can grow, heal, and express themselves creatively.

Core Services

Workshops and Empowerment Speaking Engagements:
At Mapp Holdings LLC, we offer a wide range of workshops and empowerment speaking engagements designed to address various aspects of personal development and well-being. Our workshops cover topics such as conflict resolution, emotional intelligence, stress management, communication skills, and more. We invite experts in their respective fields to lead these sessions, ensuring that participants receive the highest quality education and insights.
Education from Violence Experts:
We recognize the importance of addressing violence and its impact on individuals and communities. Our organization collaborates with violence experts to provide education and resources aimed at preventing violence, fostering healthy relationships, and promoting safety. Through these programs, we work towards creating a safer and more compassionate society.
Music Paint Sip - An Artistic Journey:
As a subsidiary of Mapp Holdings LLC, Music Paint Sip combines art, music, and therapy to offer unique and therapeutic experiences. Our themed painting events are designed to unleash creativity and promote self-expression. Participants are guided by live artists who help them create beautiful artwork while enjoying music and a supportive atmosphere. These events have proven to be both enjoyable and therapeutic for our diverse clientele.
Clientele

Mapp Holdings LLC has had the privilege of serving a wide range of clients, including corporations and educational institutions throughout New York City. Our workshops and speaking engagements have been well-received by schools, businesses, community organizations, and government agencies. Our Music Paint Sip events have provided a unique and engaging experience for individuals and groups seeking a creative outlet.

The Therapist Behind It All

At the heart of Mapp Holdings LLC is our founder and owner, a licensed marriage and family therapist. With a deep understanding of human behavior, mental health, and interpersonal dynamics, our owner brings a wealth of knowledge and expertise to our programs. This background in therapy informs our approach to empowerment and healing, ensuring that our services are not only educational but also deeply therapeutic.

Impact and Vision

Over the years, Mapp Holdings LLC has touched the lives of countless individuals, equipping them with valuable skills, fostering creativity, and promoting emotional well-being. Our vision for the future is to continue expanding our reach and impact, reaching even more people in need of empowerment, education, and healing. We aspire to be a beacon of hope and a catalyst for positive change in the lives of those we serve.

Conclusion

Mapp Holdings LLC stands as a testament to the transformative power of education, art, and therapy. We are committed to making a difference in the lives of youth and adults alike, helping them navigate life's challenges with confidence and resilience. Through our workshops, empowerment speaking engagements, and Music Paint Sip events, we aim to inspire individuals to unlock their full potential and lead happier, healthier lives. With a dedicated team and a passion for positive change, we look forward to continuing our mission of empowerment and transformation in the years to come.

business_description:
Mechanismic Inc. is an MBE NY-based corporation, which designs, develops, and manufactures a scalable, authentic, and affordable STEM Robotics Education and Play product called SnappyXO Design (https://www.snappyxo.com) for K-12 schools, post-secondary institutions, students, makers and hobbyists, and for industrial prototyping. We also sell to informal STEM learning centers, such as museums, libraries, after-school STEM programs and camps, hackathons, and robotics competitions. 

SnappyXO is not just a robot kit. It is a complete ecosystem of patented hardware, design apps, and curriculum, which brings together mechanical design, practical electronics, and computer science in a Project- and Problem-based setting.

We are the exclusive supplier of this innovative and cutting-edge product, which finally bridges the gap between competition-based robotics and programming oriented products and provides NGSS aligned curriculum to helps schools provide critical engineering design skills and knowledge to its students while developing an interest in STEM careers.

This unified and holistic product teaches students engineering design, practical electronics, and computational thinking under one umbrella and brings a new approach to STEM and robotics education, wherein students engage in the entire design innovation cycle from conceptualization to programmable robots.

SnappyXO Design features:

MotionGen Pro (http://www.motiongen.io): This is the world’s first AI-driven mechanism synthesis software that helps users design and simulate mechanisms and enables them to become the innovators and inventors. Backed by many years of academic research in the Mechanisms and Robotics area and covered extensively in peer-reviewed research publications, this software also allows students to design and 3D print or laser-cut their own robot parts.

SnappyXO Build (http://www.snappyxo.io): SnappyXO Builder app offers a new and innovative approach to building robots. Its user-friendly interface and extensive range of parts and components make it easy for anyone to create their dream robotic creations. By virtually assembling designs before building them physically, students can experiment with different configurations and refine their ideas to create truly unique and functional robots. The app also includes activity cards that offer various levels and challenges to guide students through the design process and promote hands-on learning. 


SnappyXO Hardware: This is a minimalistic library of intuitive and planar hardware components, such as flexible connectors, rigid joints, and mounts for off-the-shelf electronics such as motors, batteries, sensors and open-source microcontrollers like Arduino. The hardware is designed to be simple enough for elementary students and yet sufficiently capable for college students to design even the most complex robotic systems. The hardware also includes an extensive set of mechatronics components for rapid prototyping of robots and machines.

SnappyXO PBL Curriculum: This is a grade- and age-appropriate, project- and problem-based, standards-aligned curriculum for three grade bands, viz. elementary, middle, and high-school and college students.

SnappyXO Design was originally invented at State University of New York (SUNY) at Stony Brook in the Computer-Aided Design and Innovation Lab to provide a design-driven robotics education to students and received funding from the National Science Foundation and many NY-state organizations.

Katiuscia Gray was raised in Hollis Queens New York. Raised in a Haitian household by her grandparents and aunts and cousins. Chaos and trauma were a bit part of her life. She got a degree in Social work and then became a licensed clinical social worker, LCSW-R. During this time, she got married and had children. It was then that Mind Meets Movement counseling services, PLLC was developed. A Holistic mental health practice that incorporates a number of healing modalities including breath work, mindfulness, cognitive behavior therapy, play therapy, trauma therapy and light yoga moves, so patients can get the most out of their therapy sessions. business_description:
Oasis of Hope Counseling is a dedicated mental health practice committed to providing compassionate, trauma-informed therapeutic services to individuals and families affected by domestic violence (DV) and a wide range of emotional and psychological challenges. We specialize in supporting survivors of domestic violence, children who have witnessed abuse, and individuals navigating the lasting impact of trauma. Our mission is to offer a safe, healing environment where hope is restored, resilience is built, and lasting change is possible.

At Oasis of Hope Counseling, we believe that everyone deserves access to high-quality mental health care, especially those who have experienced life-altering trauma. We provide individual, child, and family counseling tailored to the unique needs of each client. Our clinicians are trained in evidence-based modalities and culturally competent practices to ensure that clients from all walks of life receive the care and respect they deserve.

Core Services:

Trauma Therapy: We provide specialized therapy for individuals of all ages who have experienced trauma, including physical, emotional, and sexual abuse, neglect, and loss. Our trauma-informed approach promotes healing and empowerment in a non-judgmental, supportive space.

Domestic Violence Survivor Support: We offer confidential, empowering counseling for survivors of domestic violence. Our goal is to help clients rebuild their lives, establish safety, and work through the psychological effects of abuse, including anxiety, depression, PTSD, and low self-esteem.

Child and Adolescent Therapy: Children who witness domestic violence or experience trauma require sensitive and developmentally appropriate care. Our therapists use play therapy, cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT), and expressive therapies to help children process their experiences and build healthy coping skills.

Family Counseling: We work with families to address dynamics affected by trauma, stress, and conflict. Family therapy helps improve communication, rebuild trust, and strengthen relationships in the aftermath of distressing events.

Individual Counseling: Our licensed professionals provide one-on-one counseling for adults and adolescents facing anxiety, depression, grief, anger issues, and life transitions. We help clients gain insight, develop coping strategies, and move forward with confidence.

Anger Management: We offer structured anger management programs to help clients understand the roots of their anger, learn emotional regulation techniques, and develop healthier responses to stress and conflict. This service is available for individuals, couples, or mandated clients.

Target Population:

Oasis of Hope Counseling serves a diverse client base, including:

Adult survivors of domestic violence

Children and teens who have witnessed or experienced violence

Individuals coping with trauma, anxiety, depression, or emotional regulation challenges

Families affected by domestic violence or in need of support navigating difficult life circumstances

Court-ordered clients seeking anger management or trauma-informed care

Our Approach:

Our practice is grounded in empathy, integrity, and the belief in every person’s ability to heal and thrive. We prioritize client-centered care and collaborate with each client to set meaningful goals and create personalized treatment plans. Our therapists are trained in modalities such as Trauma-Focused Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (TF-CBT), Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT), and Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing (EMDR), among others.

We partner with local shelters, schools, social services, and healthcare providers to ensure a continuum of care for our clients and reduce barriers to accessing mental health support.

At Oasis of Hope Counseling, we are more than just a counseling center — we are a sanctuary for healing, growth, and transformation.

business_description:
Passion Driven Solutions, LLC is a mission-driven, Black-owned consulting firm that partners with organizations, government agencies, philanthropic institutions, and grassroots leaders to co-create solutions that advance justice, dignity, and opportunity. Headquartered in Chicago and registered in New York, our work is deeply grounded in the lived experiences of those most impacted by systemic inequities, particularly fathers of color and the families and communities they help sustain.

We believe fathers of color are foundational to the well-being of children, families, and neighborhoods. Yet, their contributions are too often overlooked, their leadership undervalued, and their needs unmet by traditional systems of support. Passion Driven Solutions exists to change that. We equip our partners with the tools, strategies, and insights needed to recognize, engage, and uplift fathers as assets, while supporting community-led change that is culturally grounded, healing-centered, and rooted in legacy.

Our work is guided by the principle that communities possess the wisdom and resilience required to transform the very systems that have historically excluded them. We bridge research and practice, strategy and story, systems and humanity, working across sectors to ensure equity is not just an aspiration, but an operational standard.

Mission
To ignite sustainable systems change by building on community strengths, uplifting the leadership of historically marginalized fathers of color, and equipping organizations to advance equity with integrity and vision.

Core Service Areas

1. Community-Rooted Research, Evaluation, and Policy Design
We conduct rigorous, participatory research that centers the lived experience of fathers of color and other system-impacted community members. From qualitative studies and listening sessions to policy briefs and culturally responsive evaluation frameworks, our work is grounded in collaboration, cultural humility, and accountability. We help our partners translate insights into actionable strategies that drive program improvement, influence public policy, and elevate community voice.

2. Fatherhood Engagement and Family Strengthening Solutions
We help institutions design and implement father-inclusive approaches that affirm the roles of fathers of color as caregivers, protectors, nurturers, and leaders. Our services include technical assistance, curriculum development, workforce training, and strategic advising. Whether supporting early childhood educators, juvenile justice staff, or community health practitioners, we offer tools that deepen engagement, promote healing, and build social connection. Our approach reflects an intergenerational commitment to strengthening families from the inside out.

3. Strategic Planning and Organizational Capacity Building
We support mission-driven organizations in aligning their operations with their values. Our services include strategic planning, theory of change and logic model development, equity implementation planning, and leadership development. We work closely with executive teams and boards to clarify vision, build infrastructure, and cultivate a culture of impact. Our approach emphasizes sustainability, accountability, and the centering of community priorities at every stage.

Our Guiding Values

Abundance – We recognize and build on the cultural wealth, talents, and capabilities already present in communities.

Justice – We work to dismantle structural inequities and design systems that promote dignity, safety, and opportunity for all.

Authenticity – We uplift narratives and solutions that are rooted in truth, lived experience, and cultural context.

Collective Power – We believe lasting change emerges when systems follow the leadership of communities.

Excellence – We commit to delivering high-quality, thoughtful, and impactful work that honors those we serve.

Why Passion Driven Solutions?
We are more than consultants—we are co-strategists, thought partners, and champions for community-led transformation. Organizations turn to Passion Driven Solutions when they are ready to move beyond statements of equity and into sustained, meaningful action. Our work bridges intention and implementation, helping partners reimagine what’s possible for fathers, families, and communities across the country.

To learn more or explore partnership opportunities, contact us at cb@pdsllc.org.

business_description:
Founded in 1977, Pelli Clarke & Partners has earned a reputation for designing buildings that express the core values of our clients. We have designed many of the world’s most recognizable buildings. Our award-winning portfolio includes master plans, academic buildings, libraries, museums, research centers and residences, and we have served public and private clients, businesses, institutions and government agencies. Great design arises from sincere collaboration with a client and a deep respect for a project’s environmental, economic and social contexts. 

Advancing Better Communities
Our firm’s broad portfolio demonstrates our dedication to the responsiveness to site, building character, materials, and technology. As design architects, we play the central role in interpreting the varied requirements of clients and user groups, as well as assimilating and interpreting the expertise of large teams of specialized consultants. Each constituency contributes to the process as we understand constraints, recognize and encourage innovation, and interpret requirements to solve complex architectural challenges in an urban setting. 

Sustainable Design
We have been a leader in environmentally sustainable design for over a decade. Our designs included sustainable strategies even before the U.S. Green Building Council established its Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) program. Our vision of sustainability extends beyond the technical concerns of reducing a building’s energy 
consumption. To be truly sustainable, a design must address the economic and cultural factors that make a project successful long into the future. 

Urban Design and Planning
Pelli Clarke & Partners has substantial experience in the design of successful large scale commercial projects. Working with government agencies and leading developers, we have been involved in the creation of major centers around the globe. Our design expertise has helped to shape four of the world’s largest private developments: Canary Wharf in London, the World Financial Center in New York, the International Finance Centre in Hong Kong and the Kuala Lumpur City Centre. Often incorporating complex transportation systems, memorable public spaces, and significant new buildings, these developments presented significant planning challenges. Our urban projects have resolved fundamental issues including land use, traffic, parking, and pedestrian circulation while establishing guidelines for architecture, historic preservation, landscape and streetscape. Our work is sensitive and responsive to budget and schedule constraints, historic master plans, and the programmatic requirements of each project. 

Design Excellence
Our firm has been honored with critical acclaim and hundreds of design awards, including the American Institute of Architects’ most prestigious recognition for an architectural practice, the Firm Award. In 1995, the American Institute of Architects awarded Cesar Pelli the Gold Medal, its highest honor for an individual. In 2004, the firm was awarded the Aga Khan Award for Architecture for the Petronas Towers.

Actor Lynne Lambert had the idea for NYC SUBWAY LINE in 1995.  While waiting for a subway at Boro Hall, Brooklyn, she looked up at the subway sign with its big, green #4 and #5 circles and thought how these familiar generic circles with their numbers and letters, were like the wallpaper of The City.  With a son turning five years old, it occurred to Lynne that if there were a #5 train tee shirt, she would have a great birthday gift for all of her son's friends who would also be turning five that year.  Or, an #A train tee for Ali, #R for Rory, and so forth. Lynne thought the subways should be wearable, and contacted the MTA to obtain a license to do just that!  Prak Productions, Inc has had the MTA license for 24 years now.  The company first shipped in November of 1996.  Prak customers, such as Macys, Museum of the City of New York, The City Store, Top of the Rock, F.A.O. Schwarz, the NY Transit Museum stores and others, inspired Lynne to add in hats, bags, backpacks, travel accessories and many other items to the product line as the years went by. Always a favorite of both tourists and New Yorkers who love NYC, these NYC Subway Line items have been worn by celebrities, featured in magazines, newspapers and used as wardrobe in movies, TV and music videos.  Lynne’s unique business story has also been told on Donny Deutch’s “The Big Idea,” CBS News, “Bagels and Broadway” and WOR radio shows as well as in many print articles.  Prak's current array of products can be viewed at www.NYCSubwayLine.net.

Over the years, Prak had been asked to make similar products for other locales.  The most requested imagery was maps.  Buyers wanted products with maps of their own transit system, town, state or city.  Lynne decided there would be a good business making promotional products with maps on them.  Launching in 2018, Prak's new brand, MAP'T GEAR, offers something truly unique in the world of corporate gifts, employee appreciation gifts and event giveaways.  Instead of producing products with a mere company logo, MAP'T GEAR creates products which feature a company's location, the location of one or all its outposts, or of its meeting on a decorative, completely customized map.  MAP'T GEAR's current product line of messenger bags, padfolios, tees, drinkware and totes are handsome items which will actually be used or worn, unlike the majority of promotional gift items which are often tossed or donated as unwanted company advertisements.  Prak made totes for NY State’s Small Business Development Center’s 2018 conference. Prak can also make custom products which include NYC Subway maps and signs.  These and other Map't Gear products, viewable at www.MAP'TGEAR.com

Provider documentation integrity support

Documentation improvement programs

Education and process improvement initiatives

Process redesign to prevent future denials

Production and quality management

Audit tracking and outcomes reporting

Trend analysis and risk prioritization

Client-ready executive dashboards

Workforce accountability and performance governance

A revenue integrity and risk mitigation mindset, not just code assignment

Deep specialization in high-complexity and high-risk case types

Fully domestic, credentialed workforce

Physician groups and professional billing organizations

Accuracy

Richard Rosario, a passionate photographer with an innate flair for storytelling, envisioned a photography studio that would redefine the art of visual narration in the Bronx community. 4. **Product Photography:** In an increasingly digital world, the importance of high-quality product imagery cannot be overstated. Our studio offers professional product photography services designed to showcase your merchandise in the best possible light.


5. **Real Estate Photography:** Highlighting the beauty and potential of properties is crucial in the real estate industry. Richard Rosario Photography LLC specializes in capturing stunning images that accentuate the unique features of residential and commercial spaces.


**Our Commitment:**

At Richard Rosario Photography LLC, excellence is not just a goal; it's a standard by which we operate every day. From the moment you walk through our doors to the final delivery of your photographs, our team is dedicated to providing a seamless and exceptional experience that exceeds your expectations.


**Community Engagement:**

As proud members of the Bronx community, we believe in the importance of giving back. Through various outreach programs and collaborations with local organizations, Richard Rosario Photography LLC strives to use its platform to uplift and inspire the next generation of aspiring photographers.


**Looking Ahead:**

As we continue to grow and evolve, Richard Rosario Photography LLC remains committed to pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. With a focus on embracing new technologies and exploring alternative avenues of artistic expression, our studio is poised to remain a trailblazer in the world of photography for years to come.


In a world where moments are fleeting and memories are precious, Richard Rosario Photography LLC stands as a steadfast guardian of the past, present, and future. Join us as we embark on a journey to capture the beauty of life, one frame at a time.

business_description:
Elliot W. Eisner, when discussing the value of art education said that “School programs that do not provide adequate time and attention to the arts deny students access to a stunning part of their culture.” The mission at Rosebud Art Studio is to create time and attention for the students, so that they may become skilled artists and gain access to a stunning part of our visual art culture.

The studio has a group of trained, highly skilled artists who believe in the Vygotskian zone of proximal development. As dedicated art professionals and educators, the studio aims and strives to support the artistic learning process in our students by building the right kind of skill-based creative scaffolds until the student can perform as an artist independently. 

We teach Drawing, Painting, Sculpture, Printmaking, and Ceramics/Pottery for kids and adults.

In Drawing, students learn the basics of drawing using line, form, shape, and gradation. Students learn to draw still life objects, landscapes, portraits, and full figure using various drawing tools such as Ebony pencils, Charcoal pencils, Charcoal stick, Conte crayon, Oil pastels, and Artist pen.

In Painting, students learn to paint still life objects, landscapes, portraits, and full figure using various mediums like Watercolor paints, Acrylic paints, Tempera paints, and Oil paints. 

In Sculpture, students learn to make sculptures of Animals and portraits and full figures of the human body using clay, cardboard, paper, and other creative materials. Students also learn molding and casting processes.

In Printmaking, Students learn techniques like Foam Plate Etching and Collagraph Printing (younger students) and Linoleum Cut, Plexiglass Engraving and Dry Point over Zinc/Aluminum Plate Engraving (adult students).

In Ceramics, students learn to throw pots on the wheel, Trimming, and glazing. Students also learn to hand build various mugs, bowls, and plates. Students get their pots fired in the kiln at the end of each program module. 

The studio has regular, yearlong after school and weekend programs for kids to learn visual art skills throughout the year.

Recently, the studio has started teaching art skill to special needs students. This is an enriching, fulfilling, and rewarding program aimed at improving the hand and eye coordination, listening skills, following instruction skills, and other fine art skills to students with special needs.

The studio runs art camps during school holidays throughout the year. The after-school programs and the art camps help parents to engage their children in art activities that are otherwise not easily accessible to them.

In the process of learning various art skills in the studio, students also learn Art History related to artists from America and from different parts of the world. 

The studio accepts students who are passionate about art and who are interested in learning more to improve their skills!

As a Black-owned, family-operated business based in the Bronx, we are proud to serve diverse communities through accessible wellness programs, trauma informed services, and natural self-care products. Our mission is to bridge the wellness gap by offering culturally relevant practices that support the whole person—mind, body, and spirit.

We specialize in providing customized, scalable wellness programming to schools, early childhood centers, public agencies, afterschool programs, housing developments, senior centers, and community-based organizations. With a unique blend of yoga, mindfulness, music and movement (such as Zumbini®), holistic education, and natural wellness products, like smoothies and wellness drinks, our work supports social-emotional learning (SEL), mental health, emotional regulation, and community well-being.

Our offerings include:
 • Children’s Yoga & Mindfulness: Evidence-based, age-appropriate classes for preschoolers, school-age children, 
teens and college students that promote focus, self-regulation, movement, and calm.

 • Holistic Products: Our signature line of handmade, small-batch products—including magnesium sprays, essential oil inhalers, and soothing balms—support physical and emotional wellness and are often incorporated into our workshops and offerings.
 • Music & Movement for Early Childhood: Zumbini® for Schools and community programs, where we combine music, dance, and play to support early learning and bonding in a joyful, high-energy format.
 • Seasonal and Culturally Relevant Events: We also organize and lead events like community healing circles, yoga in the park, and holistic pop-ups that reflect the needs and values of the communities we serve.

Why Partner With Us
We are passionate about meeting people where they are—physically, emotionally, and culturally. Our programs are adaptable, trauma-informed, and inclusive of all bodies, abilities, and backgrounds. As a mobile business, we bring services directly to your location—whether it’s a school gym, park, shelter, library, or community center.

We are currently collaborating with local schools, early childhood programs, community organizations, and city agencies to offer services that uplift, educate, and nurture. Our work directly supports public health goals around:
 • Stress and trauma reduction
 • Mental health awareness
 • Youth empowerment and resilience
 • Family engagement
 • Community building through arts and wellness

S & S Health and Wellness is fully insured, has passed background checks for working with children and families,DOE  and is MWBE certified to expand our contracting opportunities. We are open to short-term projects, recurring contracts, and one-time events depending on your agency’s needs.

SeniorHabitat was created because 87% of caregivers are unaware of resources that can help them make critical decisions and provide proper care.  Although the United States is one of the most advanced country when it comes to medicine, it is still struggling with providing high-quality care to older adults. Rather than providing high-quality care, services is often delivered by many different providers without coordination. As a result, many older adults aren't getting their needs met and caregivers are struggling with their growing responsibilities. Rather than having caregivers feel ‘left in the lurch’ and having to “battle the system,” SeniorHabitat empowers care connections by using technology to improve continuity of care and provide better access to support services. It serves the individual needs of older adults through interactive, intelligent-driven care solutions. To improve quality of life for older adults, SeniorHabitat created a platform that provides support and guidance to stressed family caregivers by offering objective and qualified solutions for the following social determinants of health: 1) Resources to meet daily needs (ex. housing & nutrition), 2) Access to health care services, 3) Community-based resources (ex. care management), 4) Social & legal support, 5) Opportunities for recreational & leisure activities (ex. adult day & senior centers), 6) Transportation options. Our mission is to improve the quality of life (QoL) for older adults by enabling access to a comprehensive network of care providers and services.

The president and owner is Dawn Cotter-Jenkins (MA, CCC-SLP; MSHI). World Class Speech Services is a multifaceted company that provides professional solutions to improve speech and communication personal and technology needs for individuals and organizations.

1.      How much time has been wasted in miscommunication that creates disgruntled workers or customers? Losing good people and revenue, or adding expenses to readvertise to refill the position or find new customers.
2.     How much better can the people in your organization work with fewer bottlenecks in interpersonal communication? Intervening in disputes and calling in HR to mediate.
3.     What has it cost your company in wasted workflow hours to go to meeting after meeting to make decisions and strategize? What should have been done in three meetings, ends up taking six.

Speech and communication in the workplace can directly or indirectly affect the productivity and success of your company. If your employees are interacting with customers or clients, it is important for them to carry the company messages in a clear and direct manner. If they are relaying information to each other, instructions and follow-up need to be effective and direct. Employees may come from a diverse range of departments and need to both listen and speak for maximum effectiveness and timeliness, minimizing going back and forth for clarification. Leaders, employees, and clients benefit from improved communication. Whether it’s for sharing information, sales, or leadership, ongoing skills development is often needed.  

Communication challenges in many workplaces can be in:
·        Speech clarity
·        Message content
·        Listening skills
·        Interpersonal communication styles

Avoiding these challenges can save time and increase productivity and outcomes. When coworkers know how to improve their speech, voice, and communication they can express their needs and share information much more efficiently. Learning techniques and strategies for better communication, as an individual or team, can improve confidence and build collaboration. Doing so cuts down on miscommunications, allows for better feedback and follow-up, and saves time in workflow.

What makes World Class Speech Services different?

World Class Speech Services is able to address a variety of goals in all of these areas due to specialized training and decades of experience. The founder and president, Dawn Cotter-Jenkins, has been teaching and training adults since 2003 in different colleges and organizations on workplace communication, voice and diction, accent modification, and public speaking, to name a few courses.
She has worked as a:

·        University/college adjunct professor
·        Licensed and certified speech-language pathologist (SLP)

Dawn Cotter-Jenkins, of World Class Speech Services, has expanded her scope of work to include Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Accessibility (DEI&A) strategies and telepractice training and development over the past 5 years.
·        Lead the development of the NY State Licensing Board Telepractice Guidelines
·        Created a curriculum for an elective course and an internship at Adelphi University
·        Certified in Diversity, Equity and Inclusion in the Workplace from the University of South Florida  

From entry positions to the C-Suite, as a speaker, instructor, coach, trainer, and consultant, I work with many facets of workforce communication. Not only do I bring in evidence-based and innovative methods, I co-create curriculum to directly address your company's needs. Using a needs assessment, pre-training questionnaires, and interviews, World Class Speech Services will determine priorities and hone the program goals to your company’s specific high priority needs for individuals or groups. I analyze and provide strategic guidance with ongoing feedback to adress systemic and organizational needs to take you from good to great.  

World Class Speech Services is a multi-specialty company. Our unique qualifications, as compared to other speech and communication coaches, are deep and extensive layers of professional certifications and licenses in speech-language-communication assessment and intervention. Additional trainings as a speaker-trainer-coach with the John Maxwell Leadership Program, being a TEDx speaker coach, and certification and practice in Diversity, Equity and Inclusion makes me highly qualified to recognize, listen and address your needs.

business_description:
STRUT is where Caribbean spirit meets New York City precision. Founded by Shaw Bernard, a Trinidad and Tobago native with over two decades in the modeling industry, STRUT was built on the belief that fashion can be both powerful and purposeful. What began as a boutique modeling agency has grown into a dynamic ecosystem rooted in excellence, education, and empowerment.

At its core, STRUT represents diverse talent across runway, showroom, e-commerce, beauty, and commercial markets. Our models are trained not only to book jobs, but to embody Poise, Presence, Personality, and Professionalism; the 4 P’s that define our standard. We believe representation matters, and we are committed to reshaping the fashion industry into a more equitable and forward-thinking space.

In 2014, STRUT Esteem was launched as a social-emotional learning and leadership development initiative inspired by the transformative principles of modeling. What began as a confidence-building workshop has grown into a structured youth development program serving public and private schools, community organizations, and municipalities.

STRUT Esteem uses fashion as a framework to teach real-world life skills. Students learn communication, personal branding, goal setting, leadership, wellness awareness, digital responsibility, and professional etiquette. The program culminates in experiential showcases, presentations, or fashion productions that allow participants to apply what they’ve learned in a real-world setting.

More than a modeling program, STRUT Esteem is a pathway program. It introduces young people to diverse career opportunities within the fashion and creative industries, from modeling and styling to marketing, production, talent management, and entrepreneurship. Students gain exposure to industry professionals, hands-on workshops, and structured curriculum designed to build confidence, discipline, and resilience.

Today, STRUT Esteem operates as part of the broader STRUT ecosystem, bridging education, industry access, and workforce readiness. The program is adaptable for middle school, high school, and young adult participants and is aligned with social-emotional development standards and college and career readiness frameworks.

As a Black-owned and female-led organization, diversity is not a talking point ,it is our foundation. We are committed to creating access, expanding opportunity, and ensuring that the next generation sees themselves reflected not only on the runway, but in leadership.

At STRUT, we are not simply shaping talent.
We are shaping confidence, character, and community.

business_description:
Studio Elsa Ponce is a Brooklyn-based, full-service architecture and design firm specializing in community-driven projects. We bring expertise in co-creating community facilities and fostering inclusive engagement, offering services in both English and Spanish. Our interdisciplinary team delivers holistic solutions across architecture, interior design, furniture design, and graphic design, ensuring our clients experience seamless, 360° environments tailored to their needs, desires, and resources. 

Studio Elsa Ponce emerged from the belief that design should serve as a tool for social, environmental, and intergenerational equity. Inspired by the ethos of grassroots movements, we have developed a creative methodology grounded in solidarity and participation, that we adapt to the unique character of each community we serve.

We collaborate with change-making communities, nonprofits, and for-profit partners including the Workers Justice Project in Brooklyn and New Immigrant Community Empowerment (NICE) in Queens, to design culturally resonant spaces that cultivate connection and a sense of belonging. 

Our work has gained the support of organizations such as the New York State Council of the Arts (NYSCA), the Architectural League of New York, Mexico’s Endowment for the Arts (FONCA), Art Omi, and the Rema Hort Mann Foundation.

Elsa Ponce is a registered architect, educator, and founder of Studio Elsa Ponce. With a career spanning over fifteen years, Elsa has worked with award-winning design consultancies and architecture firms including Standard Issue, 2x4, Tatiana Bilbao Estudio, and TEN Arquitectos. Her portfolio spans various projects and locales, including cultural institutions, exhibitions, housing developments, and educational buildings across North America, the Caribbean, and East Asia.

Elsa has served as the Managing Director of Open Architecture Collaborative’s New York Chapter, a nonprofit organization that provides pro bono design services to underserved communities across New York City. She is a cohort member at the New Museum's NEW INC, the first museum-led cultural incubator. She teaches Professional Practice at the Spitzer School of Architecture at the City College of New York. Elsa also co-founded WIP Collaborative, a feminist practice working on projects that engage the public realm.

Elsa holds a bachelor's degree in architecture with honors from Universidad Iberoamericana in Mexico City and a Masters in Design Management from Pratt Institute in New York. She is a registered architect in New York State and Mexico.

Uncle Yankey's Pepper Sauce isn't just delicious, It’s 
Pepperlicious! ….. PEPPA!

Uncle Yankey's Pepper Sauce was created in 2021 in the midst of the Covid pandemic and although it was very daunting at first, I went along with my dream of bringing a piece of my homeland from Trinidad and Tobago to the US to share with others.
I set out to recreate Uncle Yankey’s pepper sauce from my profound memories of home by staying true to my culture by incorporating fresh fruits, fresh seasonings with only the best peppers available while developing my own niche. 
Uncle Yankey’s started as a home based business in Brooklyn where it’s now being manufactured in Cook Collective Kitchen in Brooklyn, NY.
No other companies was offering hot sauce in quite this way where we took exotic tropical fruits like pineapple, passion fruit, papaya, mango along with healthy vegetables like beets and bell peppers, mixed in with fresh seasonings and raw peppers to create a flavorful and savory hot sauce with an intense heat that will leave your palate bursting with great robust flavors that could only be found in the Caribbean. 
When I sell Uncle Yankey’s pepper sauce to my customers I just don’t want to make a sale. I want them to enjoy the experience of seeing how colorful each blends looks, smell the fragrant aroma and taste each and flavorful ingredients it’s made with so they can develop a love for my pepper sauce just like I do and become a regular where my pepper sauce will become a staple item in their home. 
As of today Uncle Yankey’s has 12 great bold flavors for everyone’s palate, pineapple, grapefruit, strawberry, tropical, virgin tropical, scorpion mango, exotic grapes, healthy beets, avocado and banana pepper sauce, avocado and homemade pepper sauce.

business_description:
Welcome to Urban Vegan Roots: A Culinary and Cultural Haven in Astoria, Queens

Urban Vegan Roots (UVR) is a pioneering 100% plant-based restaurant located on 31st Street in Astoria, Queens, designed to redefine the vegan dining experience. Brought to you by the visionary team behind Urban Vegan Kitchen, UVR stands as a vibrant cultural hub where food, art, and community converge. Our mission is to celebrate the richness of vegan cuisine while fostering an inclusive environment that welcomes everyone, regardless of dietary preferences.

At UVR, we pride ourselves on our innovative menu, featuring a delightful array of savory seitan dishes and veggie-forward creations. Each dish is thoughtfully crafted to tantalize your taste buds and dispel the myth that vegan food is bland or unsatisfying. Whether you’re a lifelong vegan or a curious newcomer, our offerings promise a culinary experience that leaves you feeling fulfilled and inspired.

More Than Just a Restaurant

UVR transcends the typical dining experience. We are a sanctuary for creativity and collaboration, inviting entrepreneurs, artists, and musicians to connect and thrive. Our space is designed to accommodate everything from intimate date nights to lively birthday parties and business gatherings. With daily happy hour specials from 12 PM to 7 PM, an extensive mocktail menu, and decadent desserts, UVR is the perfect spot for any occasion.

On weekends, join us for our brunch featuring classic tunes that help to create an atmosphere that captures the essence of New York City. Our goal is to provide a safe and welcoming environment where all guests can enjoy plant-based cuisine without judgment, while also gaining insight into the often-misunderstood culture of veganism.

Our Mission and Vision

At UVR, our mission goes beyond serving delicious food; we strive to empower our team and community. We believe in nurturing creativity, encouraging personal growth, and maximizing earning potential. Our culture is built on collaboration and compassion, and we aspire to make a positive impact on as many lives as possible through our culinary and cultural initiatives. Our years-long partnerships with Hip hop is Green, Support & Feed, The Astoria Food Pantry, and The Queensbridge Initiative speak to our commitment to foster relationships within the community to help spread the message of healthy living as well as feed those in need. As we grow, so will our reach to outlying communities who might have access to healthy food or information on the plant-based lifestyle.

Our core values guide us in everything we do:

- Inclusivity: We celebrate NYC culture and foster an environment where everyone feels welcome.
- Knowledge Sharing: Embracing the philosophy of "Each One, Teach One," we believe in the transformative power of sharing experiences and insights.
- Hard Work & Play: We are dedicated and driven, yet we also value joy and fun in our endeavors.
- Community: We are a family, committed to supporting one another and creating a sense of belonging.
- Creativity: We honor diverse artistic expressions and encourage innovative thinking.
- Compassion: We aim to spread love and joy through our culinary offerings and cultural contributions.

Join Us

We invite you to explore a unique dining experience where food meets culture, and every meal is an opportunity for connection. As a proud MWBE-certified business, we are dedicated to supporting and uplifting our community while showcasing the richness of vegan cuisine. We welcome you to come, savor our dishes, and be part of our vibrant family. Discover the flavors of compassion and creativity at Urban Vegan Roots—where everyone is welcome, and every meal tells a story.

business_description:
Vibrnt Seeds is a culturally grounded, education-driven initiative rooted in the belief that every child deserves access to hands-on learning, fresh food, and opportunities to connect with the natural world. Blooming from the urgent needs revealed during the COVID-19 pandemic, Vibrnt Seeds began as a community response to support essential workers and their families through engaging, garden-based education and food literacy programming. What started as resource kits and virtual lessons has now grown into a dynamic platform that brings urban agriculture, nutrition, and sustainability to life inside classrooms, afterschool programs, and community spaces across New York City.

At its core, Vibrnt Seeds helps young people—and the adults who guide them—rediscover the joy and power of growing food, no matter their background or living situation. Through vibrant partnerships with schools, community centers, shelters, and public housing organizations, Vibrnt Seeds installs edible garden kits, facilitates experiential workshops, and provides technical support to educators, site directors, and caregivers. The program is committed to making growing food a joyful, accessible experience—whether it’s through a hydroponic tower in a cafeteria corner, tabletop gardens in a second-grade classroom, or windowsill herb kits that children proudly take home to their families.

One of the signature features of Vibrnt Seeds is its Tabletop Garden Series, where students engage in hands-on activities that teach science, math, and storytelling through the act of growing. Each child receives their own edible herb kit, designed for indoor growing on a windowsill, which helps extend learning from school into the home. These kits aren’t just plants—they’re a pathway to understanding food systems, building healthy routines, and fostering family connection. The installations are paired with curated lesson plans and simple instructions so that educators—regardless of gardening experience—feel confident leading sessions.

Beyond the classroom, Vibrnt Seeds brings its educational mission into the broader community. The program hosts seasonal events, parent workshops, pop-up plant carts, and garden clubs that make it easy for entire families to participate in growing, cooking, and learning together. Whether working alongside school wellness councils, community-based organizations, or city agencies, Vibrnt Seeds shows up as both a collaborator and a cultivator—helping communities turn small spaces into impactful growing environments that support wellness, creativity, and food access.

Vibrnt Seeds also addresses deeper systemic challenges, such as food insecurity and environmental justice, through programs that connect students to local food sources and green career pathways. Youth are introduced to farming technologies, cultural planting traditions, and even animal husbandry as part of a broader ecosystem of sustainability education. All activities are designed to be joyful, inclusive, and reflective of the communities they serve—particularly Black and Brown youth in historically under-resourced neighborhoods.

What makes Vibrnt Seeds unique is its ability to bridge education with action. The program blends curriculum-aligned learning with real-world experiences that nurture a child’s sense of agency and belonging. At a time when school communities are seeking meaningful ways to support student mental health, family engagement, and culturally responsive learning, Vibrnt Seeds offers a model that is tactile, inspiring, and deeply rooted in care.

Agencies and partners who work with Vibrnt Seeds can expect a hands-on, collaborative process that meets their needs while uplifting the voices of their students and families. Whether you're looking to install a long-term edible garden, run a short-term workshop series, or incorporate youth-friendly wellness initiatives into your programming, Vibrnt Seeds brings passion, expertise, and a deep love for community to every project.

In a city where concrete often replaces soil and fast food overshadows fresh produce, Vibrnt Seeds offers something radical: a way for children and families to grow something real—together.

At Vontélle, we are reimagining what accessible, inclusive eyecare looks like—one student, one employee, one community at a time. As a women-owned, MWBE-certified eyewear brand, our mission extends far beyond fashion. We deliver on-site vision screenings, eye exams, and culturally inspired prescription eyewear to students, working professionals, and families across New York City.

Our mobile eyecare services are tailored to meet the diverse needs of public schools, corporate offices, and community organizations, including those serving students in temporary housing (STH), underserved populations, and employees across various industries. We partner with licensed ABO opticians and optometrists to provide compassionate, professional care—on location, where individuals feel most at ease.

Whether serving a student in the classroom or an adult in the workplace, we prioritize quality, dignity, and personalization—ensuring every individual receives properly fitting eyewear that reflects their identity and enhances their daily life.

What We Offer
On-site vision screenings and eye exams by licensed professionals.

Prescription-ready eyewear that celebrates culture, individuality, and lifestyle needs.

Flexible scheduling to accommodate schools, corporations, and community events.

Longstanding partnerships with DOE schools, nonprofits like WIN (Women in Need), and corporations.

A people-first approach that emphasizes comfort, accessibility, and cultural relevance.

We believe clear vision is a gateway to academic achievement, professional productivity, and personal empowerment. Whether it’s helping a student see the board or an employee perform with confidence, we’re proud to bring clarity—literally and figuratively—to every life we touch.

Empowering the Next Generation Through Education
Beyond vision care, Vontélle offers enrichment programs that equip students with essential skills and career exposure:

Eyewear Frame Design: From Concept to Creation
A six or twelve-week course where students learn how to design frames from idea to prototype—blending creativity, culture, and design thinking.

The Business of Entrepreneurship
A hands-on program that teaches students how to transform ideas into investor-ready business plans.

Optical Technician Career Pathway Program
A practical curriculum for high school students focused on lens crafting, frame fitting, and foundational optical care.

Vontélle is not a one-size-fits-all solution. We are a purpose-driven brand committed to vision equity, cultural relevance, and sustainable impact. Our work is about more than improving sight—it’s about building confidence, supporting educational and professional success, and creating lasting opportunities for all.

We welcome the opportunity to partner with NYCPS, local businesses, and corporate organizations to bring vision care, creativity, and empowerment to communities across New York City.
